function g74Crossings(){   // every road (roadway + sidewalks) × every rail centreline: where do they meet, and is it grade-separated?
 const out=[];for(const e of EDGES){const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b],h=_ROAD_HALF(e)+20,R={x:Math.min(a.x,b.x)-h,y:Math.min(a.y,b.y)-h,w:Math.abs(a.x-b.x)+2*h,h:Math.abs(a.y-b.y)+2*h};
  for(const g of RAIL_SEGS){for(let k=1;k<g.pts.length;k++){const p=g.pts[k-1],q=g.pts[k],n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Math.hypot(q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1])/6));let hit=null;for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const x=p[0]+(q[0]-p[0])*i/n,y=p[1]+(q[1]-p[1])*i/n;if(x>R.x&&x<R.x+R.w&&y>R.y&&y<R.y+R.h){hit=[x,y];break}}
    if(hit){const B=G74_BRIDGE,onDeck=hit[0]>=B.x0&&hit[0]<=B.x1&&R.y>=B.y0&&R.y+R.h<=B.y1,overWater=g.kind==='bridge';out.push({road:e.id,rail:g.id,x:Math.round(hit[0]),y:Math.round(hit[1]),grade:onDeck?'bridge RB-74':e.id==='CL-I4'?'bridge UX-1':e.id==='CL-I7'?'level '+(g.id==='B-LINK'?'LX-1':'LX-2'):overWater?'rail viaduct':'LEVEL'});break}}}}
 return out}
function g74ClearanceQa(){const B=G74_BRIDGE,e=byEdge['AIR-PAX'],issues=[];let samples=0,maxH=0;
 for(const [asset,ref,hgt] of G74_VEH){maxH=Math.max(maxH,hgt);if(hgt>B.clearH-.5)issues.push('height:'+asset);
  for(const dir of[1,-1])for(let t=0;t<=1;t+=.004){const p=trafficEdgePoint('AIR-PAX',dir,t);if(p.x<B.x0-80||p.x>B.x1+80)continue;samples++;const g=vehicleCollisionShape(asset,ref,p.x,p.y,p.heading);
   for(const S of B.supports){const cx=clamp(g.x,S.x,S.x+S.w),cy=clamp(g.y,S.y,S.y+S.h);if(pointSegmentDistanceSq(cx,cy,g.ax,g.ay,g.bx,g.by)<g.radius*g.radius){issues.push('support:'+asset+'@'+Math.round(p.x));break}}
   if(g.y-g.radius<B.road.y0+20||g.y+g.radius>B.road.y1-20)issues.push('off-roadway:'+asset);
   {const hit=playerStaticBodyBlockedAtFor({asset,ref},{x:p.x,y:p.y,heading:p.heading});if(hit)issues.push('static:'+asset+':'+hit)}}}   // the player's own collision test (a bus/truck driven by the player)
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)].slice(0,10),samples,maxVehicleH:maxH,clearH:B.clearH,span:[B.road.y0,B.road.y1],supports:B.supports.map(q=>[q.y,q.y+q.h])}}

 if(B.supports[0].y+B.supports[0].h!==B.road.y0||B.supports[1].y!==B.road.y1)issues.push('support-not-at-sidewalk-edge');
 for(const t of RA_TRACKS){const g=RAIL_SEG_BY_ID[t.seg];if(!g){issues.push('no-stub:'+t.id);continue}const ys=g.pts.map(p=>p[1]);if(Math.min(...ys)>B.y0-20)issues.push('stub-not-past-deck:'+t.id);if(!G74_DECK_SEGS.some(d=>d.pts[0][0]===t.x))issues.push('deck-track-misaligned:'+t.id);if(t.x-22<B.x0+6||t.x+22>B.x1-6)issues.push('track-off-deck:'+t.id);if(!E3_TRACKS.some(q=>q.x===t.x))issues.push('stub-not-on-E3-track:'+t.id)}
 if(RA_TRACK_END!==G74.railEnd76)issues.push('gate76-target');{const tail=G74.railEnd76+907;if(tail>=B.y0)issues.push('gate76-train-on-deck:'+tail)}

 // 4 · parking ≥ 160, every lot reached from a road or the lane

 return{ok:!issues.length,issues:[...new Set(issues)].slice(0,24),gate:'GATE-74',graph:[NODES.length,EDGES.length],route:path,crossings:X.length,levelCrossings:level.length,airportCrossings:air,clearance:C,parking:{total,lots},lights:G74_LIGHT_FIX,bridge:{x:[B.x0,B.x1],y:[B.y0,B.y1],clearH:B.clearH,stubs:RA_TRACKS.map(t=>[t.id,t.x,RA_TRACK_END])},lane:[L.x0,L.x1,L.y]}}

// GATE-73 · AIRPORT SHIFT NORTH (plan v4.13 · AIR-02/03/04 …). Stage 1: the runway system moves north.

//  · taxiway A centre y 548 → 92, 104 → 120 wide: a code-E aircraft (AC-CG-01, span 356) taxiing on A stays out of the runway strip;
//  · links A1/A2/A3 80 → 110 wide, 182 px long, hold-short at the strip edge;
//  · taxilane L (y 428…508) in front of the stands: pushbacks end on L, not on taxiway A; connectors B1 · A2S · GL · A3S join A and L;
//  · the band between A and the old apron edge is paved where aircraft move (west/cargo band, connectors, L + apron edges), grass elsewhere.
// Every finish pass (E1/F1/G1) is written against APT_Y, so lights, signs, PAPI, LOC, ARFF access and monitors moved with the runway.
// Stage 2 (AIR-04 · AIR-08): four jet-bridge stands P1 · P2 · P3 · P4 (gate 4), 302 px apart, each bridge from a measured gate of the
// terminal sprite to the aircraft door (angled where the door is not in front of a gate); baggage pockets A/B/C between the stands;
// O2 moves to the new NE small-aircraft apron (taxiway A east stub, service road y 590, service column, tug lane);
// S2 FINAL (plan v4.18 / AIR-22): Door L/R — P1 · P2 dock at door L, P3 · P4 at door R (ground service mirrored east); P2 + P3 belong to
// Terminal 2; every bridge leaves the terminal straight, its rotunda in line with the door, the cab beside the door;
// full stand × aircraft clearance audit (largest aircraft, full wing span) with arrival and pushback sweeps.
// S2 GROUND OPS (plan v4.21): AIR-25 support-vehicle chores stop only in the marked bays of the Ramp Services Park East (RSP_E, x 7194);
// AIR-26 baggage trains from belt C unload / load the remote stands P6 · P5 (F2_REMOTE_BAG); AIR-27 the apron buses unload and load
// visible passengers at the T3 bus gate (G2_GATE) — a hold leg at the home bay at the end of every arrival bus task and the start of every
// departure bus task.
// =====================================================================================================================================
const G73_SCOPE={id:'AIRPORT-SHIFT-NORTH',gate:'GATE-73',stage:4,sub:'4',westRow:'s3b',locked:true,shift:{runway:-720,taxiway:-616,taxilane:-194,row:-206}};   // S3a: AIR-19 applied (from v1.93: runway 290→−430, A 548→−68; from S2: L 468→274, stands/terminals −206)
const G73_CONNECTORS=[{id:'B1',x:5990,w:80},{id:'A2S',x:6600,w:110},{id:'B2',x:7276,w:80},{id:'A3S',x:7950,w:110}];   // S5b · D-68: GLN → B2
const G73_L={id:'L',x0:5950,x1:8345};   // S3b: extended east to the NE apron
const G73_WEST_EXT={id:'E1-WEST-EXT',x:4805,y:APT_Y.TS,w:1185,h:604-APT_Y.TS};          // west GA apron + cargo band (paved), x 4805–5990
const G73_PAX_EXT={id:'F1-APRON-EXT',x:5990,y:APT_Y.LN,w:1310,h:394-APT_Y.LN};          // taxilane L + the apron edge in front of the stands (S3a: apron head 394)
const G77_STRIP={id:'G77-GA-STRIP',x:7505,y:APT_Y.TS,w:195,h:APT_Y.LN-APT_Y.TS};   // GATE-77 S5b · D-71: the light-aircraft pad between B2 and A3S
const G77_LG_EXT={id:'G77-LARGE-EXT',x:6890,y:184,w:170,h:APT_Y.LN-184};   /* p401: the 747's tail at its real length (y 187) */   // GATE-77 S5c: under the huge jet's tail at x 6972   // GATE-77 S5b · D-65: the large stand widens north — its jet's tail
const G73_EAST_EXT={id:'G1-EAST-EXT',x:7300,y:APT_Y.LN,w:1045,h:600-APT_Y.LN};          // taxilane L east part + the east block edge — S3b: to x 8345 (L6 + NE apron)
// ---- stage 2: NE small-aircraft apron (G1, east of A3S) ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// row A (live, nose south): in from the taxiway A east stub, pushed back onto it, out along A to A2.  Vehicles: service road y 590 from
// the GLINK, service column x 8012 north to the tug lane in front of the noses.  Slot 2 (GA3) and the south row (GA4 / O1) follow in stage 2b.
const G73_AEXT={id:'A-EXT',x0:8030,x1:8340};
const G73_NE={...APL_ZONES.ne,rowTail:345,col:8012,road:484,slots:[8130,8270],tug:484};   // GATE-77 S5b · D-68: the straight service road IS the tug lane   // S3b: live tails 345 · tug lane 484 · static noses 507
const G73_SPACE_USES=(()=>{const Y=APT_Y,o=[];for(const [c,x] of [['E0',4800],['F0',6000],['G0',7200]]){
 o.push({id:c+'-BUFFER',x,y:-850,w:1200,h:Y.FN+850,use:'שטח חיץ מחוץ לגדר — פתוח, ללא מכשולים'},{id:c+'-PERIMETER',x,y:Y.FN,w:1200,h:Y.SN-Y.FN,use:'גדר, דרך סיור, כיסוח וניקוז'},

// ---- taxi tokens of the new pieces (a plane holds every token its fuselage touches) -------------------------------------------------------
function g73Tokens(mk,out){
 const Y=APT_Y;
 for(const [k,x0,x1] of [['L1',5950,6420],['L2',6420,6780],['L3',6780,7215],['LG',7215,7305],['L4',7305,7700],['L5',7700,8045],['L6',8045,8345]])out.push(mk(k,x0,x1,Y.LN,Y.LS));   // S3b: L6 to the NE apron
 for(const c of G73_CONNECTORS)out.push(mk(c.id,c.x-c.w/2,c.x+c.w/2,Y.TS,Y.LN));
}
// ---- routes on the new network ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// arrivals vacate at A2 (passenger / west / cargo / hardstand) or A3 (east block), cross taxiway A and come down a connector onto L
const G77_B2=7276;   // GATE-77 S5b · D-68: the link between A2S and A3S, now the taxiway B2 (lit, named)
function g73ArrLeg(sd,ac){
 const X=APTT_X,A2=X.A2,A3=X.A3,cx=sd.cx,ng=sd.ngy,tpl=sd.tpl,LY=X.LY;let pts,rad;
 if(tpl==='bridge'&&(ac==='AC-LG-01'||ac==='AC-MW-01')){pts=[[X.APP0,X.RY],[A2,X.RY],[A2,X.TY],[G77_B2,X.TY],[G77_B2,LY],[cx,LY],[cx,ng]];rad=[110,90,90,90,90,90]}   // S5b · D-71: by A2
 else if(tpl==='bridge'){
  if(Math.abs(cx-A2)<40){pts=[[X.APP0,X.RY],[A2,X.RY],[A2,ng-260],[cx,ng-130],[cx,ng]];rad=[110,400,400]}
  else{pts=[[X.APP0,X.RY],[A2,X.RY],[A2,LY],[cx,LY],[cx,ng]];rad=[110,90,90]}
 }else if(tpl==='cargo'){pts=[[X.APP0,X.RY],[A2,X.RY],[A2,X.TY],[5800,X.TY],[5800,sd.ngy],[sd.ngx,sd.ngy]];rad=[110,110,100,100]}   // S2: down the cargo band (x 5800), clear of P1's wing (B1 is 18 px too close since P1 moved west)
 else if(tpl==='hard'){pts=[[X.APP0,X.RY],[A2,X.RY],[A2,X.TY],[X.GLX,X.TY],[X.GLX,1116],[sd.ngx+50,1116],[sd.ngx+50,sd.ngy],[sd.ngx,sd.ngy]];rad=[60,60,60,40,16,16]}
 else if(tpl==='cargoS'){pts=[[X.APP0,X.RY],[A2,X.RY],[A2,X.TY],[cx,X.TY],[cx,ng]];rad=[110,90,90]}
 else if(tpl==='strip'){pts=[[X.APP0,X.RY],[A3,X.RY],[A3,X.TY],[cx,X.TY],[cx,ng]];rad=[110,60,40]}   // GATE-77 S5b · D-71: west on A, left turn in   // S3b: west cargo row, west on A, straight in
 else if(tpl==='apronSW'&&sd.zone==='ne'){pts=[[X.APP0,X.RY],[A3,X.RY],[A3,LY],[cx,LY],[cx,ng]];rad=[110,90,60]}   // S3b: NE apron, east on L, tight turn-in
 else if(tpl==='apronSW'){
  if(sd.id==='P6'){pts=[[X.APP0,X.RY],[A3,X.RY],[A3,X.TY+40],[cx,X.TY+200],[cx,ng]];rad=[110,150,150]}   // GATE-77 S5b: the S-bend on A3S, straight on L — its wing passes O2's row in line
  else if(Math.abs(cx-A3)<40){pts=[[X.APP0,X.RY],[A3,X.RY],[A3,ng-260],[cx,ng-130],[cx,ng]];rad=[110,400,400]}
  else{pts=[[X.APP0,X.RY],[A3,X.RY],[A3,LY],[cx,LY],[cx,ng]];rad=[110,90,90]}
 }else{pts=[[X.APP0,X.RY],[A2,X.RY],[A2,X.TY],[cx,X.TY],[cx,ng]];rad=[110,90,90]}   // apronSE: west apron, exit at A2, taxi west on A, straight in
 const leg=apttArrive(ac,pts,rad,sd.th);leg.park=leg.endPose();leg.park[2]=sd.th;leg.park[3]=0;leg.park[4]=1;return leg;
}
// departures: bridge stands push onto L facing west, taxi to B1, north to A, full length from A1; the east block and O2 push onto L, taxi west to A2S
// and line up at A2 (intersection departure, as before); west stands push east into their band and line up at A2 from taxiway A
function g73DepLegs(sd,ac){
 const X=APTT_X,K=APTT_CLS[ac],D={},tpl=sd.tpl,cx=sd.cx,ng=sd.ngy,LY=X.LY;
 if(tpl==='bridge'&&cx-80>X.A2+40&&g77L1Closed()){   // GATE-77 S5 · AIR-20: L1 closed → north on A2
  const yh=APT_Y.RS+48;D.push=apttPush(ac,cx,ng,{dir:-1,yE:LY});D.pe=D.push.endPose();
  D.taxi=apttTaxi(ac,[[cx-80,LY],[X.A2,LY],[X.A2,yh]],[90],Math.PI);D.hold=D.taxi.endPose();D.viaA2=true;
  D.takeoff=apttTakeoff(ac,[[X.A2,yh],[X.A2,X.RY],[X.END,X.RY]],[80],D.hold[2],Math.max(K.xLo,X.A2+AO_ROLL[ac]));
 }else if(tpl==='bridge'&&(ac==='AC-LG-01'||ac==='AC-MW-01')){   // GATE-77 S5b · D-68 · S5c: the wide-body too: pushed facing east, east on L, north on B2, west on A to A1
  const hx=X.A1+170;D.push=apttPush(ac,cx,ng,{dir:1,yE:LY,dx:90});D.pe=D.push.endPose();
  D.taxi=apttTaxi(ac,[[D.pe[0],LY],[G77_B2,LY],[G77_B2,X.TY],[hx,X.TY]],[90,90],0);D.viaB2=true;D.hold=D.taxi.endPose();
  D.takeoff=apttTakeoff(ac,[[hx,X.TY],[X.A1,X.TY],[X.A1,X.RY],[X.END,X.RY]],[85,90],D.hold[2]);
 }else if(tpl==='bridge'){
  const hx=X.A1+170;
  D.push=apttPush(ac,cx,ng,Object.assign({dir:-1,yE:LY},sd.pushOpt||{}));D.pe=D.push.endPose();
  D.taxi=apttTaxi(ac,[[cx-80,LY],[X.B1,LY],[X.B1,X.TY],[hx,X.TY]],[90,90],Math.PI);
  D.hold=D.taxi.endPose();
  D.takeoff=apttTakeoff(ac,[[hx,X.TY],[X.A1,X.TY],[X.A1,X.RY],[X.END,X.RY]],[85,90],D.hold[2]);
 }else if(tpl==='strip'){             // GATE-77 S5b · D-71: forward onto L, west to B2, north, west on A, the A2 hold
  const yh=APT_Y.RS+48;D.taxi=apttTaxi(ac,[[cx,ng],[cx,LY],[G77_B2,LY],[G77_B2,X.TY],[X.A2,X.TY],[X.A2,yh]],[40,50,50,60,60],Math.PI/2);D.hold=D.taxi.endPose();
  D.takeoff=apttTakeoff(ac,[[X.A2,yh],[X.A2,X.RY],[X.END,X.RY]],[80],D.hold[2],Math.max(K.xLo,X.A2+AO_ROLL[ac]));
 }else if(tpl==='cargoS'){            // S3b: pushed back onto taxiway A facing A1 (C1 east, C2 west), short roll to the hold, line up at A1
  const pu=sd.push||{dir:1,dx:80};
  D.push=apttPush(ac,cx,ng,{dir:pu.dir,yE:X.TY,dx:pu.dx});D.pe=D.push.endPose();
  const hx=D.pe[0]+pu.dir*16;
  D.taxi=apttTaxi(ac,[[D.pe[0],X.TY],[hx,X.TY]],[],pu.dir>0?0:Math.PI);
  D.hold=D.taxi.endPose();
  D.takeoff=apttTakeoff(ac,[[hx,X.TY],[X.A1,X.TY],[X.A1,X.RY],[X.END,X.RY]],[56,90],D.hold[2]);
 }else if(tpl==='cargo'){
  D.taxi=apttTaxi(ac,[[sd.ngx,sd.ngy],[5460,sd.ngy],[5460,X.TY],[5385,X.TY]],[60,70],Math.PI);
  D.hold=D.taxi.endPose();
  D.takeoff=apttTakeoff(ac,[[5385,X.TY],[X.A1,X.TY],[X.A1,X.RY],[X.END,X.RY]],[70,90],D.hold[2],7250);
 }else if(tpl==='hard'){
  const hx=X.A2+160;
  D.taxi=apttTaxi(ac,[[sd.ngx,sd.ngy],[X.GLX,sd.ngy],[X.GLX,X.TY],[hx,X.TY]],[50,60],Math.PI);
  D.hold=D.taxi.endPose();
  D.takeoff=apttTakeoff(ac,[[hx,X.TY],[X.A2,X.TY],[X.A2,X.RY],[X.END,X.RY]],[70,80],D.hold[2],Math.max(K.xLo,X.A2+AO_ROLL[ac]));
 }else if(tpl==='apronSW'&&(g77LEastClosed()||sd.id==='P6')){   // GATE-77 S5b · owner 05:19: L closed at the large stand → out by A3; P6 (just west of A3S) always: pushed facing east, its tail swings away from O2
  const yh=APT_Y.RS+48,yP=LY,near=cx>X.A3-100&&cx<X.A3,e=cx<X.A3-100||near?1:-1;D.push=apttPush(ac,cx,ng,near?{dir:1,yE:yP,dx:-(cx-(X.A3-95))}:{dir:e,yE:yP});D.pe=D.push.endPose();
  D.taxi=apttTaxi(ac,[[D.pe[0],yP],[X.A3,yP],[X.A3,X.TY],[X.A2,X.TY],[X.A2,yh]],[90,90,90,90],e>0?0:Math.PI);D.viaA3=true;D.hold=D.taxi.endPose();
  D.takeoff=apttTakeoff(ac,[[X.A2,yh],[X.A2,X.RY],[X.END,X.RY]],[80],D.hold[2],Math.max(APTT_CLS[ac].xLo,X.A2+AO_ROLL[ac]));
 }else if(tpl==='apronSW'){
  const yh=APT_Y.RS+48,yP=LY;   // holding on A2 just south of the hold-short line, nose north; S3b: the NE apron pushes onto L as well (A east stub removed)
  D.push=apttPush(ac,cx,ng,{dir:-1,yE:yP});D.pe=D.push.endPose();
  D.taxi=apttTaxi(ac,[[cx-80,yP],[X.A2,yP],[X.A2,yh]],[90],Math.PI);
  D.hold=D.taxi.endPose();
  D.takeoff=apttTakeoff(ac,[[X.A2,yh],[X.A2,X.RY],[X.END,X.RY]],[80],D.hold[2],Math.max(K.xLo,X.A2+AO_ROLL[ac]));
 }else{                                // apronSE: west apron, push / power-back east, taxi north in the west band, east on A, line up from A2
  const hx=X.A2-160,yE=540;
  D.push=apttPush(ac,cx,ng,{dir:1,yE});D.pe=D.push.endPose();
  D.taxi=apttTaxi(ac,[[cx+80,yE],[cx+140,yE],[cx+140,X.TY],[hx,X.TY]],[50,90],0);
  D.hold=D.taxi.endPose();
  D.takeoff=apttTakeoff(ac,[[hx,X.TY],[X.A2,X.TY],[X.A2,X.RY],[X.END,X.RY]],[85,90],D.hold[2],Math.max(K.xLo,X.A2+AO_ROLL[ac]));
 }
 return D;
}

// S2 · NE apron services (called from afDest): vehicles leave the G2 yard up the GLINK (x GLN), run east on the service road y 590,
// north on the service column and along the tug lane in front of the noses.  The tug pushes the aircraft back onto the A east stub and
// returns straight south to the service road; the fuel truck stops beside the wing (cx + 60) and turns on the spot.
function g73NeDest(role,sd,ac,TL,fy){
 const N=G73_NE,GLN=AF.GLN,GLS=AF.GLS,cx=sd.cx,c=N.col,R=N.road;
 if(R<N.y+N.h-60){   // GATE-77 S5b · D-68: the straight road y 484 in front of the noses
  const SO=APL.lanes.spineOut,SI=APL.lanes.spineIn;   // GATE-77 S6b-c · p156 · K-95: from / to the east spine (the yard rows X / Y)
  if(role==='tug')return{node:afNodeGL(),inn:[[GLN,R,26],[cx,TL,0]],crab:true,mode:'tug',backFrom:t=>t[0]<c+30?[[t[0],t[1],0],[t[0],R,30],[GLS,R,26]]:[[t[0],t[1],0],[c,t[1],24],[c,R,26],[GLS,R,26]],
   east:{node:afNodeEast(),inn:[[SO,R,24],[cx,TL,0]],backFrom:t=>[[t[0],t[1],0],[t[0],R,30],[SI,R,24]]}};
  if(role==='fuel'){const colF=cx+60;return{node:afNodeGL(),inn:[[GLN,R,26],[colF,R,22],[colF,fy,0]],mode:'pivot',back:[[colF,fy,0],[colF,R,22],[GLS,R,26]],
   east:{node:afNodeEast(),inn:[[SO,R,24],[colF,R,22],[colF,fy,0]],back:[[colF,fy,0],[colF,R,22],[SI,R,24]]}}}
  return null}
 if(role==='tug')return{node:afNodeGL(),inn:[[GLN,R,26],[c,R,22],[c,TL,22],[cx,TL,0]],crab:true,mode:'tug',backFrom:t=>t[0]<c+30?[[t[0],t[1],0],[t[0],R,30],[GLS,R,26]]:[[t[0],t[1],0],[c,t[1],24],[c,R,26],[GLS,R,26]]};   // S3b: back along L to the column x 8012, never across the parked rows
 if(role==='fuel'&&sd.id==='GA3'){const colF=cx+60;return{node:afNodeGL(),inn:[[GLN,R,26],[colF,R,22],[colF,fy,0]],mode:'pivot',back:[[colF,fy,0],[colF,R,22],[GLS,R,26]]}}
 if(role==='fuel'){const colF=cx+60;return{node:afNodeGL(),inn:[[GLN,R,26],[c,R,22],[c,TL,22],[colF,TL,22],[colF,fy,0]],mode:'pivot',back:[[colF,fy,0],[colF,TL,22],[c,TL,22],[c,R,22],[GLS,R,26]]}}
 return null;
}

// S2 FINAL · AIR-22: a passenger door on each side.  Door L is the asset's 'Door' anchor; Door R mirrors it across the centre line
// (compatibility fallback until the aircraft redesign of GATE-77 brings real Door R anchors).  Each bridge stand names its door (APT_STANDS)
// and its rotunda stands in line with that door, so the bridge leaves the terminal straight.  A stand without a door falls back to the
// door away from its ground-service side.
function g73DoorDy(s,ac,th,ngy,dx,dyL){
 if(s.door==='L'||s.door==='R')return s.door==='R'?-dyL:dyL;
 const c=Math.cos(th),sn=Math.sin(th),sv=s.svcSide||-1;
 for(const dy of [dyL,-dyL]){const x=s.cx+dx*c-dy*sn;if((Math.sign(x-s.cx)||1)!==sv)return dy}
 return dyL;
}

// ---- painting --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// north of the runway strip: mown buffer outside the fence, fence, patrol road inside it (field tiles of E1/F1/G1 cover y −850…)
function g73PaintPerimeter(g,x0,x1){
 const Y=APT_Y;g.save();
 for(let y=-850,i=0;y<Y.FN;y+=62,i++){g.fillStyle=i%2?'rgba(172,185,114,.07)':'rgba(58,85,45,.07)';g.fillRect(x0,y,x1-x0,Math.min(62,Y.FN-y))}
 g.strokeStyle='rgba(58,77,58,.35)';g.lineWidth=2;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x0,-760);g.lineTo(x1,-760);g.stroke();             // drainage swale outside the fence
 g.fillStyle=portPattern('gravel');g.fillRect(x0,Y.PR0,x1-x0,Y.PR1-Y.PR0);g.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.10)';g.fillRect(x0,Y.PR0,x1-x0,2);g.fillRect(x0,Y.PR1-2,x1-x0,2);
 g.strokeStyle='#52665c';g.lineWidth=1.4;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(x0,Y.FN);g.lineTo(x1,Y.FN);g.stroke();g.fillStyle='#46574f';for(let x=x0;x<x1;x+=30)g.fillRect(x-1.4,Y.FN-1.4,2.8,2.8);
 if(x0===6000)aptTxt(g,'AIRSIDE · PERIMETER ROAD',6600,(Y.PR0+Y.PR1)/2,9,'rgba(236,232,214,.55)',600);
 g.restore();
}
// approach lighting corridor west of the threshold (outside the chunk grid, as before)
function g73DrawNorthField(v){
 const R=APT_APPROACH_REGION;if(!portVis(v,R.x,R.y,R.w,R.h))return;
 ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='rgba(172,185,114,.10)';ctx.fillRect(R.x,APT_RWY.cy-60,R.w,120);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(58,77,58,.35)';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(R.x,APT_RWY.cy+150);ctx.lineTo(R.x+R.w,APT_RWY.cy+150);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
}
function g73PaintConnector(g,c){
 const Y=APT_Y,x0=c.x-c.w/2;
 g.fillStyle=portPattern('asphalt');g.fillRect(x0,Y.TS-4,c.w,Y.LN-Y.TS+8);
 g.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.12)';g.fillRect(x0,Y.TS,3,Y.LN-Y.TS);g.fillRect(x0+c.w-3,Y.TS,3,Y.LN-Y.TS);
 g.strokeStyle='#e0b93a';g.lineWidth=2.2;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(c.x,Y.TY);g.lineTo(c.x,Y.LY);g.stroke();
 // fillets: taxiway A centre line ⇄ connector, connector ⇄ taxilane L centre line
 g.lineWidth=1.8;for(const d of [-1,1]){g.beginPath();g.moveTo(c.x,Y.TY+70);g.quadraticCurveTo(c.x,Y.TY,c.x+d*70,Y.TY);g.stroke();g.beginPath();g.moveTo(c.x,Y.LY-70);g.quadraticCurveTo(c.x,Y.LY,c.x+d*70,Y.LY);g.stroke()}
 // taxiway edge lights along the connector (blue)
 g.fillStyle='#58a8e8';for(let y=Y.TS+30;y<Y.LN-10;y+=60)for(const sx of [x0+5,x0+c.w-5]){g.beginPath();g.arc(sx,y,2.2,0,Math.PI*2);g.fill()}

// ---- S2 · stand × aircraft clearance audit (AIR-04 / AIR-08) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Every outdoor stand × every accepted aircraft, full wing span (aplEnv: fuselage, wing / APTT_WT, tail):
//  · parked against every other stand (any accepted aircraft): no overlap; jet-bridge neighbours keep ≥ 30 px wingtip to wingtip;
//  · parked against buildings, hangar doors, service alleys, perimeter road (aplAudit) and against aircraft taxiing on A (CG, west of A2) / L;
//  · the arrival and the pushback of every live stand × aircraft swept every 0.25 s against all parked neighbours (≥ 6 px = reservation margin);
//  · jet bridges: at an angle to the front door (GATE-77 S5c · D-78: every accepted type 6°–40°), reach ≤ 165 px (or the stand's own), cab beside the door, never over a pocket / bus bay;  baggage pockets clear of every bridge-stand shape (OBB).
const G73_REQ={bridgeWing:30,margin:6,bridgeLen:165,bridgeDeg:3};
// stage 2b (approved layout): C1 turns nose-south at the west end, C2 next to it, GA3/GA4/O1 move to the NE apron.  Findings that involve
// those stands are reported as 'pending2b' in stage 2 (the v1.94 west-apron geometry), they fail the audit from stage 2b on.
const G73_PENDING_2B=new Set(G73_SCOPE.westRow==='v194'?['C1','C2','GA3','GA4','O1']:[]);   // S3a kept the v1.94 west row; S3b rebuilt it: the set is empty, every finding counts
const g73Span=ac=>{const g=apttAcGeom(ac);return(g.W[3]-g.W[2])/2/APTT_WT};
function g73Gap(a,b){if(apttObbHit(a,b,0))return 0;let lo=0,hi=400;if(apttObbHit(a,b,hi))for(let i=0;i<14;i++){const m=(lo+hi)/2;if(apttObbHit(a,b,m))hi=m;else lo=m}else return hi;return hi}
function g73EnvGap(A,B){let m=1e9;for(const a of A)for(const b of B){if(a.x0>b.x1+60||b.x0>a.x1+60||a.y0>b.y1+60||b.y0>a.y1+60)continue;m=Math.min(m,g73Gap(a,b))}return m}
function g73StandAudit(){
 aptReady();const issues=[],pending=[],R=G73_REQ,S=APL.stands.filter(s=>!s.indoor),env=(s,ac)=>{const v=g77StandView(s,ac);return aplEnv(ac,v.ngx,v.ngy,v.th)};
 const add=(msg,...ids)=>(ids.some(id=>G73_PENDING_2B.has(String(id).split('/')[0]))?pending:issues).push(msg);
 const pairs={},standGap={};
 for(let i=0;i<S.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<S.length;j++){const a=S[i],b=S[j];if(Math.abs(a.ngx-b.ngx)>700||Math.abs(a.ngy-b.ngy)>700)continue;
  let m=1e9;for(const p of a.accepts)for(const q of b.accepts){if(g77Mars(a,p,b)||g77Mars(b,q,a))continue;m=Math.min(m,g73EnvGap(env(a,p),env(b,q)))}if(m>=400)continue;
  const k=a.id+'/'+b.id;pairs[k]=Math.round(m);standGap[a.id]=Math.min(standGap[a.id]??1e9,Math.round(m));standGap[b.id]=Math.min(standGap[b.id]??1e9,Math.round(m));
  const need=a.tpl==='bridge'&&b.tpl==='bridge'?R.bridgeWing:R.margin;if(m<need)add('stand-gap '+k+' '+m.toFixed(0)+'<'+need,a.id,b.id)}
 // parked against aircraft taxiing on A: the CG (span 356) uses A west of A2 (A1 · B1 · A2); NE apron: only small aircraft on the A east stub
 const Y=APT_Y,cg=g73Span('AC-CG-01'),vsA={};
 for(const s of S)for(const ac of s.accepts){const y0=Math.min(...env(s,ac).map(b=>b.y0)),x0=Math.min(...env(s,ac).map(b=>b.x0));if(y0>Y.LN)continue;
  const big=x0<APTT_X.A2+200?cg:g73Span('AC-BJ-01'),gap=y0-(Y.TY+big);vsA[s.id]=Math.min(vsA[s.id]??1e9,Math.round(gap));if(gap<R.margin)add(s.id+'/'+ac+':into-taxiway-A-sweep '+gap.toFixed(0),s.id)}
 // arrival + pushback sweeps of every live stand against the parked neighbours (every accepted aircraft of the neighbour)
 const sweep={};let samples=0;
 for(const s of S){if(!s.live)continue;const nb=S.filter(o=>o!==s&&Math.hypot(o.ngx-s.ngx,o.ngy-s.ngy)<900);
  for(const ac of s.accepts){let arr,D;try{arr=aoArrLeg(s,ac);D=aoDepLegs(s,ac)}catch(e){issues.push(s.id+'/'+ac+':route-error '+e.message);continue}
   for(const [kind,leg,t0] of [['arr',arr,Math.max(0,arr.dur-45)],['push',D.push,0],['taxi',D.taxi,0]]){if(!leg)continue;
    let m=1e9,who='';for(let t=t0;t<=leg.dur;t+=.25){const p=leg.pose(t);if(!p||p[3]>2)continue;samples++;const me=aplEnv(ac,p[0],p[1],p[2]);
     for(const o of nb){if(Math.abs(o.ngx-p[0])>600||Math.abs(o.ngy-p[1])>600)continue;for(const q of o.accepts){if(g77Mars(s,ac,o)||g77Mars(o,q,s)||(o.large&&g77MarsLane(o.id,q)&&s.tpl==='apronSW'&&kind==='taxi'))continue;const g=g73EnvGap(me,env(o,q));if(g<m){m=g;who=o.id+'/'+q.slice(3,5)}}}}
    const k=s.id+'/'+ac.slice(3,5)+':'+kind;if(m<1e9)sweep[k]=Math.round(m)+(m<60?' ('+who+')':'');if(m<R.margin)add('sweep '+k+' ✕ '+who+' '+m.toFixed(0),s.id,who)}}}
 // jet bridges (S2 FINAL bridge fix): straight out of the terminal face with the cab beside the door — the rotunda on the terminal,
 // the design aircraft at 0° (< 0.5°), every accepted aircraft ≤ 3°, reach ≤ 165, cab centre level with the door, tunnel and cab clear of
 // the fuselage (touching allowed: ≥ −1.5 px), never over the stand's own ground-service side.  Baggage pockets vs the bridge stands' shapes.
 const bridges={};
 const g77Bays=APL.bays.filter(b=>b.zone==='F2'&&(b.kind==='BT'||b.kind==='AB')),g77BrBay={};   // GATE-77 S5c · D-78
 for(const st of APT_STANDS){if(st.cargo)continue;const sd=S.find(q=>q.id===st.id);let L=0,D=0,Dm=1e9,D0=0,sides=new Set(),svcHit=1e9,body=1e9,lev=0;
  const sv=sd.svcSide||-1,cols=[36,58,100,135].map(o=>st.cx+o*sv),tb=aptFp(aptB(st.term)),nat=APTT_SPEC.jb.an.find(q=>q[0]==='Terminal End')[2]-APTT_SPEC.jb.an.find(q=>q[0]==='Door End')[2];
  if(st.gateX-15<tb.x||st.gateX+15>tb.x+tb.w)issues.push(st.id+':bridge-off-terminal');
  for(const ac of sd.accepts){const vw=g77StandView(sd,ac),vcx=vw.viewFor?vw.cx:st.cx,vcols=vw.viewFor?[36,58,100,135].map(o=>vcx+o*(vw.svcSide||-1)):cols,B=f2BridgeGeometry(st,{ac,sd:vw.viewFor?vw:{th:sd.th,ngy:sd.ngy}},1),Pk=g77BridgePose(st,{ac,sd:vw.viewFor?vw:{th:sd.th,ngy:sd.ngy}},1),vx=B.dock[0]-B.terminal[0],vy=B.dock[1]-B.terminal[1],len=Pk.dk?Pk.dk.D+G77_K72.cabD:Math.hypot(vx,vy),deg=Pk.dk?Math.abs(Pk.dk.al)*180/Math.PI:Math.abs(Math.atan2(vx,-vy))*180/Math.PI,a=Math.atan2(vy,vx);   // K-72
   L=Math.max(L,len);D=Math.max(D,deg);Dm=Math.min(Dm,deg);if(ac===(sd.first||st.aircraft))D0=deg;{const P=g77BridgePose(st,{ac,sd:vw.viewFor?vw:{th:sd.th,ngy:sd.ngy}},1),P0=g77BridgePose(st,null,0);for(const [Q,k] of [[P,'docked'],[P0,'rest']]){const br=apttObb(Q.R[0],Q.R[1],Q.th,[-10,Q.L,-8,8],'Q','br'),bc=apttObb(Q.cab[0],Q.cab[1],Q.ca,[-9,9,-10,10],'Q','cab');for(const b of g77Bays){const o=apttObb(b.x,(b.y0+b.y1)/2,0,[-b.w/2,b.w/2,-(b.y1-b.y0)/2,(b.y1-b.y0)/2],'V',b.id),g=Math.min(g73Gap(br,o),g73Gap(bc,o)),kk=st.id+'/'+b.id;g77BrBay[kk]=Math.min(g77BrBay[kk]??1e9,Math.round(g));if(g<2)issues.push(st.id+':bridge-over-bay '+b.id+' ('+k+(k==='docked'?' '+ac.slice(3,5):'')+') '+g.toFixed(0))}}}const side=B.door[0]<vcx?-1:1;sides.add((side<0?'R':'L')===(vw.door||sd.door||'L')?(sd.door||'L'):'?'+ac);
   const k=B.reach/nat,ce=B.reach+APT_JB_CABC*k;lev=Math.max(lev,Pk.dk?Math.hypot(Pk.front[0]-Pk.dk.door[0],Pk.front[1]-Pk.dk.door[1]):Math.abs(B.terminal[1]+Math.sin(a)*ce-B.door[1]));   // cab centre level with the door
   // clearance to the fuselage box (nose-south stands): tunnel half width 10 up to the cab, cab half width 11 to its bumper
   const g=apttAcGeom(ac);{const Pq=g77BridgePose(st,{ac,sd:vw.viewFor?vw:{th:sd.th,ngy:sd.ngy}},1),fu=apttObb(vcx,vw.ngy??sd.ngy,sd.th,g.F,'F',ac),tun=apttObb(Pq.R[0],Pq.R[1],Pq.th,[0,Pq.L,-7,7],'Q','tun'),cab=apttObb(Pq.cab[0],Pq.cab[1],Pq.ca,[-9,9,-10,10],'Q','cab');
    body=Math.min(body,g73Gap(tun,fu));if(apttObbHit(cab,fu,-1.5))body=Math.min(body,-2)}   // GATE-77 S5c · D-78: the angled tunnel and the cab as boxes
   // service-side rule: the bridge (half width 12, rotunda to bumper) never lies over the stand's own ground-service columns (vehicle half width 11)
   const br=apttObb(Pk.R[0],Pk.R[1],0,[-G77_K72.rr,G77_K72.rr,-G77_K72.rr,G77_K72.rr],'Q','br'),bw=apttObb(Pk.W[0],Pk.W[1],Pk.th,[-3,3,-9,9],'Q','bw');   // K-72: the rotunda's column and the wheels
   const {fy}=afPos(vw,ac);for(const x of vcols){const col=apttObb(x,(fy-60+AF.L)/2,0,[-11,11,-(AF.L-fy+60)/2,(AF.L-fy+60)/2],'Q','col');svcHit=Math.min(svcHit,g73Gap(br,col),g73Gap(bw,col))}}
  bridges[st.id]={terminal:st.term.slice(-1),door:[...sides].join('/'),baseX:Math.round(st.gateX*10)/10,service:sv<0?'W':'E',len:Math.round(L),deg:+D0.toFixed(2),degMin:+Dm.toFixed(1),degMax:+D.toFixed(1),cabLevel:+lev.toFixed(1),bodyGap:+body.toFixed(1),serviceGap:Math.round(svcHit)};
  if(L>(G77_BR_LEN[st.id]||R.bridgeLen))issues.push(st.id+':bridge-reach '+L.toFixed(0));
  if(Dm<(G77_BR_MIN_AT[st.id]??G77_BR_MIN)||D>G77_BR_MAX)issues.push(st.id+':bridge-angle '+Dm.toFixed(1)+'…'+D.toFixed(1)+'° (range '+G77_BR_MIN+'–'+G77_BR_MAX+')');   // GATE-77 S5c · D-78: at an angle, not along the fuselage
  if(lev>1)issues.push(st.id+':cab-not-at-door '+lev.toFixed(1));
  if(body<1)issues.push(st.id+':bridge-over-fuselage '+body.toFixed(1));
  if(sides.size!==1||[...sides][0]!==(sd.door||'L'))issues.push(st.id+':door-side '+[...sides].join('/'));
  if(svcHit<1)issues.push(st.id+':bridge-over-service-side')}
 const pocket={};
 for(const b of APL.bays.filter(b=>b.zone==='F2'&&b.kind==='BT')){const o=apttObb(b.x,(b.y0+b.y1)/2,0,[-b.w/2,b.w/2,-(b.y1-b.y0)/2,(b.y1-b.y0)/2],'V',b.id);
  let m=1e9;for(const s of S.filter(s=>s.tpl==='bridge'))for(const ac of s.accepts)m=Math.min(m,g73EnvGap([o],env(s,ac)));pocket[b.id]=Math.round(m);if(m<R.margin)issues.push(b.id+':pocket-in-stand '+m.toFixed(0))}
 const la=aplAudit();for(const q of la.issues)issues.push('layout '+q);
 return{ok:!issues.length,issues,pending2b:pending,bridgeStands:APT_STANDS.filter(s=>!s.cargo).map(s=>s.id+'@'+Math.round(s.cx)),standGaps:pairs,vsTaxiwayA:vsA,sweeps:sweep,samples,bridges,pockets:pocket,bridgeBays:g77BrBay}
}
// ---- QA ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function g73Paved(){
 const Y=APT_Y,R=APT_RWY,T=APT_TWY,r=(x0,y0,x1,y1,id)=>({id,x0,y0,x1,y1});
 const out=[r(R.x0-90,R.cy-R.w/2,R.x1+90,R.cy+R.w/2,'RWY'),r(T.x0-40,T.cy-T.w/2,T.x1+40,T.cy+T.w/2,'TWY'),
  r(G73_WEST_EXT.x,G73_WEST_EXT.y,G73_WEST_EXT.x+G73_WEST_EXT.w,G73_WEST_EXT.y+G73_WEST_EXT.h,'WEST-EXT'),r(G73_PAX_EXT.x,G73_PAX_EXT.y,G73_PAX_EXT.x+G73_PAX_EXT.w,G73_PAX_EXT.y+G73_PAX_EXT.h,'PAX-EXT'),
  r(G73_EAST_EXT.x,G73_EAST_EXT.y,G73_EAST_EXT.x+G73_EAST_EXT.w,G73_EAST_EXT.y+G73_EAST_EXT.h,'EAST-EXT'),

 // stands south of L: the largest aircraft on L never reaches a parked aircraft (tail tip / wing)

  for(const [n,leg] of legs)for(let t=0;t<=leg.dur;t+=.5){const p=leg.pose(t);if(!p||p[3]>2)continue;samples++;if(!onPave(p[0],p[1]))off.add(sd.id+'/'+ac.slice(3,5)+':'+n+'@'+Math.round(p[0])+','+Math.round(p[1]))}}}

const PERF_METHOD_TABLE=[['Camera.update','player',()=>[Camera,'update'],'misc'],['Camera.freeUpdate','player',()=>[Camera,'freeUpdate'],'misc'],['Targets.ui','ui',()=>[Targets,'ui'],'ui'],['Targets.draw','ui',()=>[Targets,'draw'],'ui']];
/* ===== p700 · LOGI (D‑538, the owner 8.11 08:11 — instead of L1, D‑498): the supply lines, for real =====
   Every line whose pick-up point and drop point already stand in the game is driven by a vehicle of the simulation (rules 25 / 32):
   a truck in TRAFFIC_CARS, on the c5 profile of the road core — it follows its own route of edges (the shortest legal way on the
   lanes: one-way streets, no U-turn, no future road, not the port) and stops at the end of it. There it leaves the road on the point's
   own way (a right turn into a driveway, never a reverse on a road, never over a kerb), stands at its bay and works: the hose to the
   tank, the loading arm, the forklift out of the warehouse door, the stacker of the supermarket. The cargo leaves the truck only when
   a pallet / the fuel goes out of it, and appears where it went. Then out on the point's own way, a wait at the edge of the road for a
   gap (as a car out of a driveway), back into the network, to the next point. At night (out of its hours) it stands at its home bay.
   The lines, the points and the ones that wait — LOGI.lines / LOGI.waiting (the table: deliver/2026-11-08/logi/supply_lines.json). */
var LOGI={on:true,err:null,veh:[],t:0,stats:{trips:0,loads:0,unloads:0,entries:0,merges:0,routes:0,noRoute:0,maxEntryWait:0,maxMergeWait:0,maxBlk:0,forcedNone:0},log:[]};
function lgMaxW(g,k){const W=LOGI.stats.waits=LOGI.stats.waits||{},key=g.site+':'+k;if(!W[key]||W[key][0]<g.wait)W[key]=[+g.wait.toFixed(1),String(g.waitBy||'')]}
function lgLog(v,what){LOGI.log.push({t:+LOGI.t.toFixed(1),id:v.id,what});if(LOGI.log.length>200)LOGI.log.shift()}
function lgArc(P,cx,cy,r,a0,a1,n){for(let i=1;i<=n;i++){const t=a0+(a1-a0)*i/n;P.push([cx+r*Math.cos(t),cy+r*Math.sin(t)])}return P}
function lgEase(P,x0,y0,x1,y1,n,ax){for(let i=1;i<=n;i++){const u=i/n,s=(1-Math.cos(Math.PI*u))/2;P.push(ax==='y'?[x0+(x1-x0)*s,y0+(y1-y0)*u]:[x0+(x1-x0)*u,y0+(y1-y0)*s])}return P}
function lgLine(P,x,y,step){const a=P[P.length-1],L=Math.hypot(x-a[0],y-a[1]),n=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(L/(step||12)));for(let i=1;i<=n;i++)P.push([a[0]+(x-a[0])*i/n,a[1]+(y-a[1])*i/n]);return P}
function lgPath(P){const pts=[];for(const p of P){const q=pts[pts.length-1];if(!q||Math.hypot(p[0]-q.x,p[1]-q.y)>.05)pts.push({x:p[0],y:p[1],s:0})}
 for(let i=1;i<pts.length;i++)pts[i].s=pts[i-1].s+Math.hypot(pts[i].x-pts[i-1].x,pts[i].y-pts[i-1].y);return{pts,total:pts.length?pts[pts.length-1].s:0}}
function lgAt(P,s){const A=P.pts;if(A.length<2)return{x:A[0].x,y:A[0].y};s=Math.max(0,Math.min(P.total,s));let i=1;while(i<A.length-1&&A[i].s<s)i++;const a=A[i-1],b=A[i],f=(s-a.s)/Math.max(1e-6,b.s-a.s);return{x:a.x+(b.x-a.x)*f,y:a.y+(b.y-a.y)*f}}
function lgPose(P,s){const p=lgAt(P,s),a=lgAt(P,Math.max(0,s-7)),b=lgAt(P,Math.min(P.total,s+7));let h=Math.atan2(b.y-a.y,b.x-a.x);if(!(Math.hypot(b.x-a.x,b.y-a.y)>.01)){const A=P.pts,n=A.length;h=Math.atan2(A[n-1].y-A[Math.max(0,n-2)].y,A[n-1].x-A[Math.max(0,n-2)].x)}return{x:p.x,y:p.y,heading:h}}
function lgTurn(h,to,dt){let d=to-h;while(d>Math.PI)d-=2*Math.PI;while(d<-Math.PI)d+=2*Math.PI;return h+d*Math.min(1,dt*7)}
function lgMinOfDay(){try{const c=gameClock(),m=+c.min;return Number.isFinite(m)?((m%1440)+1440)%1440:720}catch(e){return 720}}
function lgInHours(H){const m=lgMinOfDay();return m>=H[0]*60&&m<H[1]*60}
/* ---- the route on the lanes: Dijkstra over (edge, direction) — a movement must exist (one-way streets and turns as the road core has them) ---- */
function lgEdgeOk(e){return !!e&&!e.future&&!pgRestrictedEdge(e)&&!P560_NOCAR.has(e.id)}
function lgRoute(fromEdge,fromDir,toEdge,toDir){const key=(e,d)=>e+'|'+d,start=key(fromEdge,fromDir),goal=key(toEdge,toDir);if(start===goal)return[{edgeId:fromEdge,dirSign:fromDir}];
 const dist=new Map([[start,0]]),prev=new Map(),open=[[0,fromEdge,fromDir]],done=new Set();
 while(open.length){let bi=0;for(let i=1;i<open.length;i++)if(open[i][0]<open[bi][0])bi=i;const [d,e,dir]=open.splice(bi,1)[0],k=key(e,dir);if(done.has(k))continue;done.add(k);if(k===goal)break;
  const ln=lane2(e,dir,0);if(!ln)continue;const cnt=ln.cnt||1;
  for(let j=0;j<cnt;j++){const L=lane2(e,dir,j);if(!L)continue;for(const m of L.moves){if(m.kind==='uturn'||m.to.edge===e)continue;if(!lgEdgeOk(m.to.e)||m.to.acc)continue;
   const k2=key(m.to.edge,m.to.dir);if(done.has(k2))continue;const nd=d+L.len+(m.kind==='left'?60:m.kind==='right'?18:0);if(nd<(dist.has(k2)?dist.get(k2):Infinity)){dist.set(k2,nd);prev.set(k2,k);open.push([nd,m.to.edge,m.to.dir])}}}}

/* ---- who is near: every vehicle that moves or stands on a lane, in a yard, in the fleet, the player ---- */
function lgOthers(v){const L=[];try{for(const o of TRAFFIC_CARS)if(o!==v)L.push(o)}catch(e){}try{for(const o of BUS_VEHICLES)L.push(o)}catch(e){}try{for(const o of D4_YARD_SEMIS)L.push(o)}catch(e){}try{for(const o of a4FleetActors())L.push(o)}catch(e){}return L}
function lgFleetHit(v,p){try{const me=vehicleCollisionShape(v.asset,v.ref,p.x,p.y,p.heading);for(const o of a4FleetActors()){if(Math.abs(o.x-p.x)>200||Math.abs(o.y-p.y)>200)continue;if(vehicleBodiesOverlap(me,vehicleCollisionShape(o.asset,o.ref||'Truck',o.x,o.y,o.heading),1.5))return o.id}
 for(const o of LOGI.veh){if(o===v||Math.abs(o.x-p.x)>200||Math.abs(o.y-p.y)>200)continue;if(vehicleBodiesOverlap(me,trafficVehicleShape(o),1.5))return o.id}}catch(e){}return null}
/* a way is clear: nobody on it (every 10 px of it, the body and a margin), nobody coming in the watched boxes (a moving vehicle heading the watched way), not the player */
function lgAheadClear(v,J){try{const ln=lane2(J.edge,J.dir,J.k||0);if(!ln)return null;const pts=[];for(let d=0;d<=150;d+=15){const u=J.t+d/ln.len;if(u>1)break;pts.push(trafficEdgePoint(J.edge,J.dir,u,J.k||0))}
 for(const o of lgOthers(v)){if(!(o.x>-9000)||(o.speed||0)>4)continue;for(const q of pts)if(Math.hypot(o.x-q.x,o.y-q.y)<(o.radius||14)+16)return o.id||'?'}}catch(e){}return null}
function lgWayClear(v,P,watch){const pts=[];for(let s=0;s<=P.total;s+=10)pts.push(lgAt(P,s));pts.push(lgAt(P,P.total));
 let fl=null;try{fl=new Set(a4FleetActors())}catch(e){}
 let mine=null;const myBodies=()=>{if(!mine){mine=[];for(let s=0;s<=P.total;s+=10){const q=lgPose(P,s);mine.push(vehicleCollisionShape(v.asset,v.ref,q.x,q.y,q.heading))}}return mine};
 for(const o of lgOthers(v)){if(!(o.x>-9000))continue;
  /* a van / tanker of the fleet: when it stands (its bay, its stop) — only its body against the bodies of this truck along the way; when it moves — its own length round its point */
  if(fl&&fl.has(o)&&!((o.speed||0)>.5)){let hit=false;try{const ob=vehicleCollisionShape(o.asset,o.ref||'Truck',o.x,o.y,o.heading);for(const b of myBodies())if(Math.abs(b.x-ob.x)<200&&Math.abs(b.y-ob.y)<200&&vehicleBodiesOverlap(b,ob,5)){hit=true;break}}catch(e){}if(hit)return o.id||'?';continue}
  const r=fl&&fl.has(o)?80:(o.radius||16)+18;   /* a moving one: farther than the 88 px at which the van is held (it never starts inside the van's corridor) */for(const q of pts)if(Math.abs(o.x-q.x)<r+30&&Math.hypot(o.x-q.x,o.y-q.y)<r+16)return o.id||'?';
  for(const w of watch||[]){const B=w.box;if(o.x<B[0]||o.x>B[2]||o.y<B[1]||o.y>B[3])continue;if(w.any)return o.id||'?';const hx=Math.cos(o.heading||0),hy=Math.sin(o.heading||0);if((o.speed||0)>1.5&&hx*w.dir[0]+hy*w.dir[1]>.5)return o.id||'?'}}
 try{if(PlayerCar&&PlayerCar.x>-9000)for(const q of pts)if(Math.hypot(PlayerCar.x-q.x,PlayerCar.y-q.y)<40)return'PLAYER-CAR'}catch(e){}
 return null}

function lgSetPath(v,P,mode){const g=v.logi;g.path=P;g.s=0;g.wait=0;v.c5.mode=mode;v.speed=0;v.wait=false}
function lgDrive(v,dt,parked,vmax){const g=v.logi,P=g.path,room=P.total-g.s,want=Math.min(vmax,Math.sqrt(55*Math.max(0,room))+2.5);v.speed=Math.min(want,(v.speed||0)+22*dt);

/* back into the network at the join point of the site, with the route to the next site */

function lgRejoin(v,tAt){const g=v.logi,s=LOGI.sites[g.site],J=Object.assign({},s.join,tAt!=null?{t:tAt}:{}),nx=LOGI.sites[lgNextSite(v)],A=nx.arrive;

/* it cannot turn in yet (the yard is busy): it does not stand on the road — it drives round the block and comes again (as the semis of D4 do) */
function lgGoAround(v){const g=v.logi,s=LOGI.sites[g.site],A=s.arrive;let best=null;
 for(let j=0;j<((lane2(A.edge,A.dir,0)||{}).cnt||1);j++){const L=lane2(A.edge,A.dir,j);if(!L)continue;for(const m of L.moves){if(m.kind==='uturn'||!lgEdgeOk(m.to.e)||m.to.acc)continue;const r=lgRoute(m.to.edge,m.to.dir,A.edge,A.dir);if(!r||r.length<2)continue;
  let d=0;for(const q of r){const e=byEdge[q.edgeId];d+=e?Math.hypot(byNode[e.a].x-byNode[e.b].x,byNode[e.a].y-byNode[e.b].y):0}if(!best||d<best.d)best={d,r:[{edgeId:A.edge,dirSign:A.dir},...r]}}}
 if(!best)return false;Object.assign(v.c5,{mode:'road',route:best.r,finalT:A.t,purpose:'logi',path:null});v.routeIndex=0;v.edgeId=A.edge;v.dirSign=A.dir;v.c2=null;v.plan=null;v.turn=null;v.runKey=null;v.wait=false;v.speed=0;
 g.to=g.site;g.site=null;g.phase='road';LOGI.stats.around=(LOGI.stats.around||0)+1;lgLog(v,'round the block → '+g.to+' ('+best.r.length+' edges)');return true}

function perfPathStep(t){const P=PERF.path;let d=(t-P.t0)/1000*PERF_PATH_SPEED;for(let i=1;i<PERF_PATH.length;i++){const a=PERF_PATH[i-1],b=PERF_PATH[i],l=Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);if(d<=l){Camera.x=a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*d/l;Camera.y=a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*d/l;return}d-=l}const e=PERF_PATH[PERF_PATH.length-1];Camera.x=e[0];Camera.y=e[1];P.done=true}
async function perfPathRun(){PERF.timeOfs=0;if(typeof SIM_BENCH_OFS!=='undefined')SIM_BENCH_OFS=SIM_RAIL_BASE;perfCamera({x:PERF_PATH[0][0],y:PERF_PATH[0][1],zoom:1.1});await perfWait(1500);PERF.path={t0:performance.now(),done:false};const sec=perfPathLen()/PERF_PATH_SPEED;
 try{const m=await perfMeasure(sec,{profile:false});return{seconds:perfR(sec,1),fps:m.fps,frameMs:m.frameMs,jsMs:m.jsMs,over50:m.over50,over100:m.over100,stallsPerMin:m.stallsPerMin,low1Fps:m.low1Fps,heapMB:m.heapMB,canvasMB:m.canvasMB}}finally{PERF.path=null}}
function perfZoom(s){return s.fit?perfR(Math.min(innerWidth/s.fit[0],innerHeight/s.fit[1]),3):s.zoom}
function perfCamera(s){if(!State.mapQa)toggleMapQa();State.mapOpen=false;try{setMapOpen(false)}catch{}if(State.phoneOpen)try{setPhoneOpen(false)}catch{}Camera.x=s.x;Camera.y=s.y;Camera.zoom=perfZoom(s);Input.held.clear()}

// the moment of the rail schedule where FRT-1 stands at the E6 quay (W1) and the C6 work train SHT-C6 drives on W2 inside the port camera
function perfPortTime(){ // S3+: the rail / port schedule runs on SIM_LOOP.simNow (one SIM clock); before S3 on the page clock
 // absolute moment (ms since the page started) — the port flow, the ships and the rail timetable are functions of absolute time,
 // so the same moment shows the same port in every run and in every build; the scan starts one hour in (never in the past)
 const now=(typeof SIM_LOOP!=='undefined'&&SIM_LOOP.simNow!=null)?SIM_LOOP.simNow:performance.now(),base=now<3.0e6?3.6e6:Math.ceil((now+6e5)/6e5)*6e5,cam=PERF_SCN.port,vw=innerWidth/cam.zoom/2,vh=innerHeight/cam.zoom/2,inCam=c=>Math.abs(c.x-cam.x)<vw&&Math.abs(c.y-cam.y)<vh;
 let best=null;for(let s=0;s<3600;s+=1){const t=base+s*1000,snap=rlSnap(t);let frt=null,sht=null;
  for(const q of snap){const id=q.S.T.id||q.S.T.label||'';if(/FRT-?1/.test(id)&&q.cars.some(c=>c.x>=4800&&c.x<=6000&&Math.abs(c.y-5120)<20))frt=q;if(/SHT/.test(id)&&q.cars.some(c=>Math.abs(c.y-5158)<20&&inCam(c)))sht=q}
  if(frt&&sht){const sc=sht.cars.filter(inCam).length+frt.cars.filter(inCam).length;if(!best||sc>best.sc)best={s,sc};if(sc>=8)break}}
 __rlSnapT=null;const T=best?base+best.s*1000:base;PERF.portAbs=T;return T-now}

 if(s.apt){info.airport=perfAirportForward(180);try{info.aircraft=AO.ac?AO.ac.length:undefined}catch{}}
 if(s.port){const ofs=perfPortTime();if(typeof SIM_BENCH_OFS!=='undefined'){SIM_BENCH_OFS=PERF.portAbs-SIM_LOOP.simNow;PERF.timeOfs=0;const tw=performance.now();try{flFrame(PERF.portAbs)}catch{}info.portPrepMs=perfR(performance.now()-tw,1)}else if(typeof SIM_LOOP!=='undefined'&&SIM_LOOP.simNow!=null){SIM_LOOP.simNow=PERF.portAbs;SIM_LOOP.acc=0;PERF.timeOfs=0;const tw=performance.now();try{flFrame(PERF.portAbs)}catch{}info.portPrepMs=perfR(performance.now()-tw,1)}else PERF.timeOfs=ofs;info.timeOffsetS=perfR(ofs/1000,0);info.portAbsS=perfR(PERF.portAbs/1000,0)}

// ---- growth test (QA-72 · 4) — test switch only: doubles the road vehicles that are outside the camera, then removes them ----
function perfInView(x,y,pad=200){const hw=innerWidth/Camera.zoom/2+pad,hh=innerHeight/Camera.zoom/2+pad;return Math.abs(x-Camera.x)<hw&&Math.abs(y-Camera.y)<hh}
function perfGrowth(on){
 if(on){if(PERF.growth)return PERF.growth.length;const n=TRAFFIC_CARS.filter(v=>!v.c5&&!perfInView(v.x,v.y)).length,add=[];
  const slots=TRAFFIC_SEED_SLOTS.filter(id=>{const e=byEdge[id];if(!e)return false;const a=byNode[e.a],b=byNode[e.b];return a&&b&&!perfInView(a.x,a.y,400)&&!perfInView(b.x,b.y,400)});
  for(let i=0;i<n&&slots.length;i++){const edgeId=slots[i%slots.length],lap=Math.floor(i/slots.length),spec=pickTrafficAsset(i),dirSign=(i+lap)%2?1:-1,t=.1+((i*.37+lap*.21)%.8),e=byEdge[edgeId],lanePref=i%2,lane=e?.cls==='main'?i%3:e?.cls==='arterial'?lanePref:0,p=trafficEdgePoint(edgeId,dirSign,t,lane);
   const v={id:'PERF-GROW-'+(i+1),asset:spec.asset,ref:spec.ref,kind:spec.kind,label:spec.label||'רכב',edgeId,dirSign,t,lane,lanePref,laneTarget:lane,x:p.x,y:p.y,heading:p.heading,speed:0,targetSpeed:95+(i%4)*10,wait:false,hop:i,stuck:0,ghost:0,plan:null,runKey:null,c2:null,perfGrowth:true};
   TRAFFIC_CARS.push(v);add.push(v)}
  PERF.growth=add;try{CORE2_STATS.placeFix=true}catch{}return add.length}
 if(!PERF.growth)return 0;const ids=new Set(PERF.growth.map(v=>v.id));for(let i=TRAFFIC_CARS.length-1;i>=0;i--)if(ids.has(TRAFFIC_CARS[i].id))TRAFFIC_CARS.splice(i,1);const n=PERF.growth.length;PERF.growth=null;return n}

 // A/B/A/B windows (base, doubled, base, doubled) — the drift of a long scene cancels out; compare the means

  const v={id:tag+(i+1),asset:spec.asset,ref:spec.ref,kind:spec.kind,label:spec.label||'רכב',edgeId,dirSign,t,lane,lanePref,laneTarget:lane,x:p.x,y:p.y,heading:p.heading,speed:0,targetSpeed:95+(i%4)*10,wait:false,hop:i,stuck:0,ghost:0,plan:null,runKey:null,c2:null,perfGrowth:true};TRAFFIC_CARS.push(v);add.push(v)}
 try{CORE2_STATS.placeFix=true}catch{}return add}

// ---- graphics acceleration check ----
function perfGpuInfo(){
 if(PERF.gpu)return PERF.gpu;let renderer='',vendor='',webgl=false;
 try{const c=document.createElement('canvas'),gl=c.getContext('webgl')||c.getContext('experimental-webgl');if(gl){webgl=true;const ext=gl.getExtension('WEBGL_debug_renderer_info');renderer=ext?gl.getParameter(ext.UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL):gl.getParameter(gl.RENDERER);vendor=ext?gl.getParameter(ext.UNMASKED_VENDOR_WEBGL):gl.getParameter(gl.VENDOR);try{gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context')?.loseContext()}catch{}}}catch{}

  note:!webgl?'WebGL לא זמין — כנראה שהאצת הגרפיקה כבויה':soft?'רינדור תוכנה — האצת הגרפיקה כבויה: Chrome → הגדרות → מערכת → "השתמש בהאצת גרפיקה כשהיא זמינה"':'האצת הגרפיקה פעילה'};

// ---- one scenario of the benchmark: clean window (FPS / frame time / SIM / memory) + profiled window (per system) + draw operations ----
async function perfRun(name,{seconds=12,profSeconds=8,opsSeconds=3,warm=3,cold=3,ops=true,profile=true}={}){
 PERF.busy=true;try{const info=await perfScenario(name);
  // cold: the first seconds after the camera arrives (first entry into the area — caches that are made here show up as stalls)
  const c0=cold>0?await perfMeasure(cold,{profile:false,minFrames:3}):null;await perfWait(Math.max(0,warm-cold)*1000+1000);
  let clean=await perfMeasure(seconds,{profile:false,ops:false}),inval=perfInvalid(clean),retried=null;if(inval){retried=inval;perfHudStatus('מדידה לא תקפה ('+inval+') — מודד שוב פעם אחת');await perfWait(2000);clean=await perfMeasure(seconds,{profile:false,ops:false});inval=perfInvalid(clean)}let prof=null,o=null;
  if(profile)prof=await perfMeasure(profSeconds,{profile:true,ops:false});
  let oi=null,gq=null;if(ops){try{g77GpuReset()}catch(e){}let q=null;try{q=await perfMeasure(opsSeconds,{profile:false,ops:true})}finally{try{gq=g77GpuTake(q)}catch(e){}}o=q.ops;oi=q.load?q.load.drawImagePerFrame:null}   /* D-216 (c) */
  const r={...info,cold:c0?{fps:c0.fps,maxMs:c0.frameMs.max,over50:c0.over50,over100:c0.over100}:null,fps:clean.fps,low1Fps:clean.low1Fps,frameMs:clean.frameMs,jsMs:clean.jsMs,sim:clean.sim,over33:clean.over33,over50:clean.over50,over100:clean.over100,stallsPerMin:clean.stallsPerMin,gcEstimate:clean.gcEstimate,heapMB:clean.heapMB,canvasMB:clean.canvasMB,longTasks:clean.longTasks,stalls:clean.stalls,ops:o,load:clean.load?{...clean.load,drawImagePerFrame:oi}:null,frames:clean.frames,gd:gq,valid:!inval,invalid:inval||undefined,retried:retried||undefined};
  if(prof){r.cats=prof.cats;r.kinds=prof.kinds;r.profiledJsMs=prof.jsMs;r.topFunctions=prof.topFunctions.slice(0,12);r.budget=perfBudget(prof.kinds,prof.jsMs.avg)}
  return r}finally{PERF.busy=false}}
function perfBudget(k,js){const over=PERF_KINDS.filter(x=>k[x]>PERF_BUDGET[x]),margin=perfR(PERF_BUDGET.frame-js,1);return{ok:!over.length&&margin>=PERF_BUDGET.margin,over,marginMs:margin}}
const PERF_MODE=/[#&]webgl\b/.test(location.hash)?(/[#&]pq\b/.test(location.hash)?'webgl+pq':'webgl'):(/[#&]pq\b/.test(location.hash)?'pq':'normal'),PERF_MODE_HE={normal:'רגיל',webgl:'עם WebGL',pq:'עם pq','webgl+pq':'WebGL + pq',all:'הכול ברצף'};
const PERF_LAST_KEY='turbo_city_bench_last_v1'+(PERF_MODE==='normal'?'':'_'+PERF_MODE),PERF_SEQ_KEY='turbo_city_bench_seq_v1',PERF_SEQ=['normal','webgl'];   /* PERF-08 · the owner's run x 3: pq out of the sequence */
function perfLastReport(){try{const r=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PERF_LAST_KEY)||'null');return r&&r.scenarios?r:null}catch{return null}}
function perfCompare(cur,prev){
 if(!prev)return null;const out={build:prev.build,date:prev.date,scenarios:{}};
 for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(cur.scenarios)){const p=prev.scenarios[k];if(!p||!p.frameMs||!v.frameMs)continue;if(v.invalid||p.invalid){out.scenarios[k]={invalid:true,why:v.invalid||('המדידה הקודמת: '+p.invalid)};continue}const d=perfR((v.frameMs.p95-p.frameMs.p95)/Math.max(.1,p.frameMs.p95)*100,1);out.scenarios[k]={p95Before:p.frameMs.p95,p95Now:v.frameMs.p95,deltaPct:d,regression:d>10,fpsBefore:p.fps,fpsNow:v.fps}}
 return out}
async function perfBenchmark({seconds=12,longMinutes=1,route=PERF_ROUTE,growth=true,pan=true,stress=true,onStep=null}={}){
 if(PERF.busy)return null;const T0=performance.now(),saved={mapQa:State.mapQa,x:Camera.x,y:Camera.y,zoom:Camera.zoom};
 const out={tool:'Turbo City PERF-04 benchmark v1',mode:PERF_MODE,build:BUILD,version:VER,gate:ACTIVE_GATE,ua:navigator.userAgent,viewport:innerWidth+'×'+innerHeight,dpr,screen:screen.width+'×'+screen.height,
  benchMode:!!window.__TC_BENCH,seed:window.__TC_BENCH?.seed??null,gpu:perfGpuInfo(),date:new Date().toISOString(),budgetMs:PERF_BUDGET,scenarios:{}};
 const steps=route.length+(growth?2:0)+(pan?2:0)+(stress?1:0)+(longMinutes>0?1:0);let k=0;const step=t=>{k++;perfHudStatus(`Benchmark ${k}/${steps}: ${t}`);onStep&&onStep(k,steps,t)};
 try{for(const n of route){step(PERF_SCN[n].label);out.scenarios[n]=await perfRun(n,{seconds})
   if(n==='city'&&growth){step('מבחן גדילה — הכפלת הרכבים שמחוץ למסך');PERF.busy=true;try{out.growth=await perfGrowthTest(6)}finally{PERF.busy=false}
    step('מבחן צפיפות ×2 בתוך המסך');PERF.busy=true;try{out.density=await perfDensityTest(6)}finally{PERF.busy=false}}}
  if(pan){step('מעבר בין Chunks — מסלול מצלמה, פעם ראשונה (cold)');PERF.busy=true;try{out.panCold=await perfPathRun();step('מעבר בין Chunks — אותו מסלול שוב (warm)');out.panWarm=await perfPathRun()}finally{PERF.busy=false}}
  if(stress){step('מצב Stress לעתיד — כמויות סוף התוכנית (חלקי)');PERF.busy=true;try{await perfScenario('extreme');await perfWait(2000);out.stress=await perfStressTest(10)}finally{PERF.busy=false}}
  if(longMinutes>0){step('ריצה ארוכה: '+longMinutes+' דק׳');PERF.busy=true;try{await perfScenario('long');await perfWait(2000);const m=await perfMeasure(longMinutes*60,{profile:false});out.long={minutes:longMinutes,fps:m.fps,low1Fps:m.low1Fps,frameMs:m.frameMs,over50:m.over50,over100:m.over100,stallsPerMin:m.stallsPerMin,heapMB:m.heapMB,canvasMB:m.canvasMB,gcEstimate:m.gcEstimate,longTasks:m.longTasks,stalls:m.stalls}}finally{PERF.busy=false}}}
 finally{PERF.timeOfs=0;if(typeof SIM_BENCH_OFS!=='undefined')SIM_BENCH_OFS=SIM_RAIL_BASE;if(State.mapQa!==saved.mapQa)toggleMapQa();Camera.x=saved.x;Camera.y=saved.y;Camera.zoom=saved.zoom;perfFrameHook(false)}
 out.totalS=perfR((performance.now()-T0)/1000,0);out.memory={heapMB:perfHeap()!=null?Math.round(perfHeap()):null,canvasMB:perfCanvasMem(),limitMB:500};
 const prev=perfLastReport();if(prev&&prev.build!==BUILD)out.compare=perfCompare(out,prev);else if(prev&&prev.compareBase&&prev.compareBase.build!==BUILD)out.compare=perfCompare(out,prev.compareBase);
 try{const keep={...out,compareBase:prev&&prev.build!==BUILD?{build:prev.build,date:prev.date,scenarios:prev.scenarios}:(prev?.compareBase||null)};localStorage.setItem(PERF_LAST_KEY,JSON.stringify(keep))}catch{}

function perfReportText(r){

function tcF9Count(frames) { return new Promise(res => { const P = CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype, orig = {}, cnt = {}; let n = 0, fr = 0, done = false;
  for (const k of Object.getOwnPropertyNames(P)) { if (k === 'constructor') continue; const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(P, k); if (!d || typeof d.value !== 'function') continue; const f = d.value; orig[k] = f; P[k] = function () { n++; cnt[k] = (cnt[k] || 0) + 1; return f.apply(this, arguments) } }
  const end = () => { if (done) return; done = true; for (const k in orig) P[k] = orig[k]; res({ frames: fr, calls: n, perFrame: fr ? Math.round(n / fr) : 0, top: Object.entries(cnt).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 8) }) };
  const tick = () => { if (done) return; fr++; if (fr >= frames) { end(); return } requestAnimationFrame(tick) }; requestAnimationFrame(tick); setTimeout(end, 4000 + frames * 100) }) }
function tcF9Frames(n) { return new Promise(res => { let k = 0; const t = () => { if (++k >= n) res(); else requestAnimationFrame(t) }; requestAnimationFrame(t) }) }

 /* וקטור ההפרדה הקטן ביותר בין שני מצולעים קמורים (מבחן הציר המפריד); null — אין חפיפה. הכיוון — מ-Bp אל A */
 function mtv(A,Bp){let best=1e9,bx=0,by=0;for(const Q of[A,Bp])for(let i=0;i<Q.length;i++){const a=Q[i],c=Q[(i+1)%Q.length];let nx=c[1]-a[1],ny=a[0]-c[0];const l=Math.hypot(nx,ny)||1;nx/=l;ny/=l;let a0=1e9,a1=-1e9,b0=1e9,b1=-1e9;
   for(const q of A){const d=q[0]*nx+q[1]*ny;if(d<a0)a0=d;if(d>a1)a1=d}for(const q of Bp){const d=q[0]*nx+q[1]*ny;if(d<b0)b0=d;if(d>b1)b1=d}const o=Math.min(a1,b1)-Math.max(a0,b0);if(o<=0)return null;if(o<best){best=o;const sg=(a0+a1)<(b0+b1)?-1:1;bx=nx*sg*o;by=ny*sg*o}}return[bx,by]}

 /* קצה אצבע מרופד: כמה להזיז את הגוף לרוחב (בציר x בלבד) כדי לצאת מהמזחים שהוא נוגע בהם; null — אם צריך יותר מ-mx פיקס׳ או לשני הכיוונים (אז זו מכה של ממש) */
 function bandX(H,y0,y1){let c0=1e9,c1=-1e9;const add=x=>{if(x<c0)c0=x;if(x>c1)c1=x};for(let i=0;i<H.length;i++){const a=H[i],q=H[(i+1)%H.length];if(a[1]>=y0&&a[1]<=y1)add(a[0]);
   for(const yy of[y0,y1])if((a[1]-yy)*(q[1]-yy)<0)add(a[0]+(q[0]-a[0])*(yy-a[1])/(q[1]-a[1]))}return c1>=c0?[c0,c1]:null}   /* הרוחב של הגוף בתוך רצועה אופקית (בדיוק — לא לפי המלבן החוסם) */
 function hullPushX(b,x,y,h,mx){const H=obb(x,y,h,b.L*.97,b.B*.92),R=b.L+40;let lo=0,hi=0;
  for(const d of F34_DECKS){if(d[0]>x+R||d[2]<x-R||d[1]>y+R||d[3]<y-R)continue;if(!sat(H,rectP(d)))continue;const c=bandX(H,d[1],d[3]);if(!c)continue;if(x<(d[0]+d[2])/2)lo=Math.min(lo,d[0]-c[1]);else hi=Math.max(hi,d[2]-c[0])}
  if(lo&&hi)return null;const sx=lo||hi;if(!sx||Math.abs(sx)>mx)return null;return sx+Math.sign(sx)*.4}
 function trail(b){const t=NOW();if(Math.abs(b.u)<5)return;const T=b.trail;if(T.length&&t-T[T.length-1].t<100)return;T.push({x:b.x-Math.cos(b.h)*b.L*.5,y:b.y-Math.sin(b.h)*b.L*.5,h:b.h,u:Math.abs(b.u),t});if(T.length>80)T.shift()}
 /* ---- 10.11 (הבעלים: "בזמן דייג הספינה זזה מדי — היא לא נשארת במקום איפה שיש את הדגים") — העוגן ----

 function anchorDrop(b,quiet){if(b.anchor&&b.anchor.st!=='up')return false;const W=seaNow(),R=cl(10+b.L*.1,12,28);let ax=b.x,ay=b.y;const sp=(S.f&&S.f.spot)||nearSpot(b.x,b.y);

 function anchorUp(b,why){if(!b||!b.anchor||b.anchor.st==='up')return false;b.anchor.st='up';b.anchor.t0=NOW();if(why)toast(why);return true}
 function anchorHold(b,dt,nx,ny){const A=b.anchor;if(A.st==='up'&&NOW()-A.t0>1500){b.anchor=null;if(S.aboard===b.id)toast('העוגן למעלה — אפשר לשוט');return[nx,ny]}
  const vx=nx-A.x,vy=ny-A.y,dd=Math.hypot(vx,vy);if(dd>A.R){const k=Math.max(A.R,dd-8*dt)/dd;nx=A.x+vx*k;ny=A.y+vy*k}b.u*=Math.pow(.15,dt);b.vl*=Math.pow(.15,dt);
  const ht=Math.atan2(A.py-ny,A.px-nx);b.h=ang(b.h+cl(ang(ht-b.h),-.06*dt,.06*dt));return[nx,ny]}
 function anchorDraw(c,b,now){const A=b.anchor;if(!A)return;const L=b.L||60,B=b.B||22,fb=(b.fb||1)*KZ,c0=Math.cos(b.h),s0=Math.sin(b.h),bx=b.x+c0*L*.47,by=b.y+s0*L*.47;
  let dx=A.px-bx,dy=A.py-by;const dl=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;dx/=dl;dy/=dl;const k=Math.min(dl,4+L*.05),wx=bx+dx*k,wy=by+dy*k,t=NOW();

 /* ---- הפיזיקה של הסירה: מצערת, הגה, סחף, רוח וגלים (השחקן) ---- */
 /* 10.11 09:43 (הבעלים: "בלי לעשות כלום הוא נוגע בקיר ונתקע בגלל הסחף"): מים שקטים — האגן, והמעגן של השחקן (HOOK.calm): בלי סחף של רוח וזרם, בלי טלטול של גלים, ועד 5 קשר.
    נמדד ב-S7F283 בנהיגה במקשים (fx_dockDrive.js): במעגן החדש (מחוץ לאגן) הסחף המלא — כ-4.9 פיקס׳ לשנייה ברוח של 13 קשר — דחף כל סירה אל האצבע תוך 8 שנ׳ בלי מקשים (3–11 פיקס׳, 8–12 מגעים). */
 const calmAt=(x,y)=>inBasin(x,y)||!!(HOOK.calm&&HOOK.calm(x,y));
 function physics(b,dt,thr,rud){const inB=calmAt(b.x,b.y),W=seaNow(),acc=b.acc,c1=acc*.4/b.maxV,c2=acc*.6/(b.maxV*b.maxV);
  b.u+=(thr*acc-c1*b.u-c2*b.u*Math.abs(b.u))*dt;if(inB&&b.u>BASIN_V)b.u=Math.max(BASIN_V,b.u-acc*1.6*dt);if(b.u<-b.maxV*.3)b.u=-b.maxV*.3;
  const sp=Math.abs(b.u),auth=cl(sp/(b.maxV*.3),0,1),pivot=sp<b.maxV*.12?.45:0,rt=rud*(b.turn*auth*(b.u<0?-1:1)+pivot);b.r+=(rt-b.r)*Math.min(1,dt*2.2);
  const t=NOW()/1000,h0=b.h;b.h=ang(b.h+b.r*dt+(inB?0:Math.sin(t*.8+b.ph)*.014*W.wave*dt));b.vl+=(-b.u*b.r*.32-b.vl*1.4)*dt;
  const dr=inB?0:(.32*W.wind+.6)*(1-cl(sp/60,0,.85)),dx=Math.cos(W.dir)*dr,dy=Math.sin(W.dir)*dr,fx=Math.cos(b.h),fy=Math.sin(b.h);
  let nx=b.x+(fx*b.u-fy*b.vl+dx)*dt,ny=b.y+(fy*b.u+fx*b.vl+dy)*dt;
  if(b.anchor){const q=anchorHold(b,dt,nx,ny);nx=q[0];ny=q[1]}   /* העוגן מחזיק את הסירה במקום */
  if(nx>9350||ny>7450||nx<-2600){b.u*=.9;nx=cl(nx,-2600,9350);ny=Math.min(ny,7450);if(!b.edgeT||NOW()-b.edgeT>4000){b.edgeT=NOW();toast('קצה הים של העיר — הסירה מאטה ונעצרת')}}   /* D‑153: הגבול הרך */
  const hit=hullHit(b,nx,ny,b.h);if(hit){const imp=Math.abs(b.u),soft=hit!=='החוף'&&hit!=='קו המצופים של הרחצה',mx=nx-b.x,my=ny-b.y;let slid=null;
   /* 10.11 09:43: קודם — כל צעד שנגע במזח בוטל, והסחף (או ההגה) גרם שכל צעד ייגע: הסירה נתקעה ולא יצאה גם אחורה (נמדד ב-S7F283: 3 היתקעויות של 4 שנ׳ ב-S).
      עכשיו, מול מזח, אצבע או סירה: (א) הסירה נהדפת החוצה לאורך הנורמל של הקיר ומחליקה לאורכו — רק אם ההדיפה נגד כיוון התנועה (לא דרך האצבע הצרה);
      (ב) או זזה רק בציר אחד (המזחים והאצבעות ישרים); (ג) ואם גם זה נוגע — הצעד מתבטל, והסיבוב של הצעד הזה מתבטל (לא מסתובבים לתוך הקיר) */
   if(soft&&Math.abs(my)>1.5*Math.abs(mx)){const sx=hullPushX(b,nx,ny,b.h,5);if(sx!=null&&!hullHit(b,nx+sx,ny,b.h))slid=[nx+sx,ny,Math.sign(sx),0,.98]}   /* נכנסים או יוצאים מהמקום ונוגעים קצת בקצה של אצבע — האצבע המרופדת מסיטה את הסירה הצידה, והיא ממשיכה */
   if(soft&&!slid){const Pp=hullPush(b,nx,ny,b.h);if(Pp&&Pp[0]*mx+Pp[1]*my<=.25*Math.hypot(Pp[0],Pp[1])*Math.hypot(mx,my)&&!hullHit(b,nx+Pp[0],ny+Pp[1],b.h))slid=[nx+Pp[0],ny+Pp[1],Pp[0],Pp[1]];
    else if(Math.abs(mx)>.02&&!hullHit(b,nx,b.y,b.h))slid=[nx,b.y,0,-Math.sign(my)||1];else if(Math.abs(my)>.02&&!hullHit(b,b.x,ny,b.h))slid=[b.x,ny,-Math.sign(mx)||1,0]}
   if(slid){b.x=slid[0];b.y=slid[1];const pl=Math.hypot(slid[2],slid[3])||1,ux=slid[2]/pl,uy=slid[3]/pl,vx=fx*b.u-fy*b.vl,vy=fy*b.u+fx*b.vl,vn=vx*ux+vy*uy;
    if(vn<0){const wx=vx-1.3*vn*ux,wy=vy-1.3*vn*uy;b.u=(wx*fx+wy*fy)*(slid[4]||.85);b.vl=(-wx*fy+wy*fx)*.5}b.r*=.5}
   else{b.h=h0;b.u*=-.25;b.vl=0;b.r*=.3;const P0=soft?hullPush(b,b.x,b.y,b.h):null;if(P0&&!hullHit(b,b.x+P0[0],b.y+P0[1],b.h)){b.x+=P0[0];b.y+=P0[1]}}
   const fresh=NOW()-(b.bumpT||0)>700;b.bumpT=NOW();if(fresh){b.hitN=(b.hitN||0)+1;b.lastHit=hit;try{p599Shake&&p599Shake(2)}catch(e){}}if(fresh&&(imp>18||b.school)&&NOW()-b.hitT>1500){b.hitT=NOW();toast('הסירה נגעה ב'+hit+(b.school?' — במבחן זו פגיעה':' — לאט!'))}}else{b.x=nx;b.y=ny}
  trail(b)}
 /* ---- הטייס של המועדון: נתיב של קטעים (קדימה, אחורה, סיבוב במקום, המתנה) — תנועה רציפה, בלי קפיצות ---- */
 function moveBy(b,dt){b.x+=Math.cos(b.h)*b.u*dt;b.y+=Math.sin(b.h)*b.u*dt;b.r=0;b.vl*=.9;trail(b)}
 function autopilot(b,dt){const L=b.legs[0];if(!L){arrive(b);return}
  if(L.k==='settle'){if(L.t==null){L.t=0;L.x0=b.x;L.y0=b.y;L.h0=b.h;L.dh=ang(L.h-b.h)}L.t+=dt;const u=cl(L.t/L.T,0,1),e=u*u*(3-2*u);b.x=lerp(L.x0,L.x,e);b.y=lerp(L.y0,L.y,e);b.h=ang(L.h0+L.dh*e);b.u=0;b.r=0;b.vl=0;if(u>=1){b.h=ang(L.h);b.legs.shift()}return}   /* D‑587: נצמדת בעדינות — בלי סיבוב */
  if(L.k==='pivot'){const d=ang(L.h-b.h),w=cl(d*1.6,-.55,.55);b.h=ang(b.h+w*dt);b.u*=Math.pow(.15,dt);moveBy(b,dt);if(Math.abs(d)<.02&&Math.abs(b.u)<3)b.legs.shift();return}
  if(L.k==='hold'){L.t-=dt;b.u*=Math.pow(.3,dt);moveBy(b,dt);if(L.t<=0)b.legs.shift();return}
  const dx=L.x-b.x,dy=L.y-b.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),want=Math.atan2(dy,dx)+(L.rev?Math.PI:0),dh=ang(want-b.h);
  if(d<(L.tol||5)){b.legs.shift();if(L.end){b.x=L.x;b.y=L.y}return}
  if(L.end&&d<16){const k=Math.min(1,dt*2.5);b.x+=dx*k;b.y+=dy*k;b.u*=Math.pow(.2,dt);b.r=0;return}   /* D‑587: הסוף של הכניסה למעגן — גלישה ישרה, בלי להסתובב סביב הנקודה */
  const vmax=Math.min(L.v||b.maxV*.6,inBasin(b.x,b.y)?BASIN_V:1e9),vT=(L.rev?-1:1)*Math.min(vmax,Math.max(5,d*.8))*(Math.abs(dh)>.8?.3:1);
  b.h=ang(b.h+cl(dh*2.2,-1,1)*(Math.abs(b.u)>4?b.turn*.9:.5)*dt);b.u+=cl(vT-b.u,-b.acc*1.4*dt,b.acc*dt);moveBy(b,dt)}
 function arrive(b){if(b.onArrive){const f=b.onArrive;b.onArrive=null;return f(b)}if(b.mode==='return'||b.mode==='moor'){const wasMoor=b.mode==='moor';b.mode='moored';b.u=0;b.h=b.moorH!=null?b.moorH:b.be.h;b.moorH=null;save(b);if(wasMoor&&S.aboard===b.id)stepAshore(b,'berth')}else if(b.mode==='auto'){if(b.school&&S.exam&&S.exam.demo){b.mode='moor';b.legs=legsHome(b);return}b.mode='player';S.demo=null}}
 const go=(x,y,v,o)=>Object.assign({k:'go',x,y,v},o||{}),pivot=h=>({k:'pivot',h});

 function seaLine(x0,y0,x1,y1){for(let i=1;i<=14;i++){const x=lerp(x0,x1,i/14),y=lerp(y0,y1,i/14);if(!w3IsSea(x,y)||(x>SWIM[0]-20&&x<SWIM[2]+20&&y>SWIM[1]-20&&y<SWIM[3]+20)||(HOOK.keep&&HOOK.keep(x,y)))return false}return true}

  if(inBasin(b.x,b.y)){const ly=b.y<2010?LANES[0]:b.y<2350?LANES[1]:LANES[2],rev=Math.abs(ang(Math.atan2(ly-b.y,0)-b.h))>Math.PI/2;if(Math.abs(b.y-ly)>6)L.push(go(b.x,ly,9,{rev,tol:4}));

 /* D‑587: עגינה — הסירה בתוך המקום של המעגן: נצמדת בעדינות למרכז ולכיוון הקרוב (החרטום פנימה או החוצה — מה שקרוב יותר; לכל היותר ±90°) */
 function inBerth(b){const r=b.be.rect;return b.x>r[0]-6&&b.x<r[2]+6&&b.y>r[1]-10&&b.y<r[3]+10}

 function helmLocal(b){return b.helm||(b.kind==='console'?[-b.L*.1,0]:[-b.L*.22,0])}
 function aftLocal(b,side){return[-b.L*.33,side*b.B*.16]}

 function nearDeck(x,y,r){let best=null,bd=1e9;for(const d of[...S9DF.piers.map(q=>q.rect),S9DF.fuel_pontoon.rect,[6560,1819,7200,1880],...(HOOK.decks?HOOK.decks():[])]){const px=cl(x,d[0],d[2]),py=cl(y,d[1],d[3]),dd=Math.hypot(x-px,y-py);if(dd<bd){bd=dd;best=[px,py]}}return bd<=r?best:null}

 function examStep(b,dt){const e=S.exam;if(!e||e.phase!=='run')return;const t=(NOW()-e.t0)/1000;
  if(t>EXAM.limit)return examFail('הזמן נגמר (4 דקות)');if((b.hitN||0)>e.hitN0){e.hits=(b.hitN||0)-e.hitN0;e.hitV=1;return examFail('פגיעה ב'+(b.lastHit||'מזח')+' — במבחן אסור לגעת')}

 const TUNE={w0:2.2,w1:4.4,react:.8,over:2.0,reel:1.25};   /* היה: 3.5 + עד 7 שנ׳ המתנה לנשיכה, וגלגול רגיל (D‑570 — "גג 3 דגים בשעה") */
 function simFight(q,row,cfg,W,b){const rod=RODS3[cfg.rod],pow=row.weightKg*q.pow*.32,dt=1/30;let line=(row.depthM||20)+6+Math.random()*6,T=.35,stam=1,runT=0,run=0,tt=0;
  for(;tt<240;tt+=dt){if(tt>runT){const big=Math.random()<.45;run=big?(.45+Math.random()*.55)*stam:.12*stam;runT=tt+(big?.9+Math.random()*1.9:.7+Math.random()*1.3)}
   const ratio=cl(pow*run/rod.line,0,2.2),noise=W.wave*.07*Math.sin(tt*1000/140)+(W.storm?.08*Math.sin(tt*1000/57):0),hold=T<.7;let Tt;
   if(hold){line=Math.max(0,line-rod.spd*TUNE.reel*(1-Math.min(.88,ratio*.75))*dt);Tt=.24+ratio*.62+noise}else{if(run>.3)line+=ratio*4.2*dt;Tt=.1+ratio*.36+noise*.5}
   T+=(Tt-T)*Math.min(1,dt*4.5);stam=Math.max(.18,stam-dt*(hold?.045:.02)*(run>.3?1.6:1));
   if(q.id==='FS-SE-05'&&tt<4.5&&!hold&&Math.random()<.035*dt)return{t:tt,ok:false};if(T>=1||line>rod.cap||Math.random()<(.004+W.wave*.004)*dt*(hold?1:.5))return{t:tt,ok:false};
   if(line<=1.6){const tool=TOOLS3[cfg.tool],ok=b.tools.includes(cfg.tool)&&row.weightKg<=tool.max;if(!ok&&Math.random()<.55)return{t:tt,ok:false};return{t:tt+.9+2.8,ok:true}}}return{t:tt,ok:false}}
 function rateSim(hours,o){o=o||{};const tune=Object.assign({},TUNE),old=o.old;if(old)Object.assign(TUNE,{w0:3.5,w1:7,reel:1});const secH=60/(G84_CLOCK.rate||.5),out=[];
  try{for(const b of BOATS.filter(q=>!q.school))for(const s of SPOTS)for(const h of[6,12,22]){const W=seaAt(1+(h%3),h),bottom=s.bottom,cfg=defaultCfg(b,s,bottom);let t=0,n=0,big=0,val=0,lost=0;const bb=Object.assign({},b,{u:0});
     while(t<hours*secH){const rows=weights(cfg,s,bottom,W,h,bb),sum=rows.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.w,0);t+=TUNE.over+1.1+effDepth(cfg,bottom,W)/((WEIGHTS3[cfg.weight].sink||3)*1.6);if(sum<.05){t+=9;continue}
      t+=(TUNE.w0+Math.random()*TUNE.w1)/cl(sum/14,.35,1.7)+TUNE.react;let r=Math.random()*sum,q=rows[0].q;for(const x of rows){r-=x.w;if(r<=0){q=x.q;break}}
      const row=makeRow(q,pickSize(RODS3[cfg.rod].cls,BAITS3[cfg.bait].key),{spot:s,cfg,depth:effDepth(cfg,bottom,W)}),F=simFight(q,row,cfg,W,b);t+=F.t;if(F.ok){if(t>hours*secH)break;n++;val+=row.value;if(row.sizeIndex>=2)big++}else{lost++;t+=1.5}}
     out.push({boat:b.name,spot:s.name,hour:h,perHour:+(n/hours).toFixed(2),bigPerHour:+(big/hours).toFixed(2),valuePerHour:Math.round(val/hours),avgValue:n?Math.round(val/n):0,lostPerHour:+(lost/hours).toFixed(2)})}}finally{Object.assign(TUNE,tune)}
  const by=k=>{const g={};for(const r of out){(g[r[k]]=g[r[k]]||[]).push(r)}return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(g).map(([n,L])=>[n,{perHour:+(L.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.perHour,0)/L.length).toFixed(2),bigPerHour:+(L.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.bigPerHour,0)/L.length).toFixed(2),valuePerHour:Math.round(L.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.valuePerHour,0)/L.length),avgValue:Math.round(L.reduce((a,r)=>a+r.avgValue,0)/L.length)}]))};
  const common=['FS-SE-02','FS-SE-04','FS-SE-05','FS-SE-07','FS-SE-12'].map(id=>SEA_ID[id].value),two=Math.round(2*common.reduce((a,v)=>a+v,0)/common.length);
  return{hours,secPerGameHour:secH,byBoat:by('boat'),bySpot:by('spot'),rows:out,twoCommonFish:two,prices:BOATS.filter(q=>!q.school).map(b=>({boat:b.name,before:b.price0,after:b.price}))}}

 function effDepth(cfg,bottom,W){const w=WEIGHTS3[cfg.weight],drift=1-cl((W.wind-8)*.025+(W.wave-.6)*.12,0,.5),mx=cfg.weight==='w0'?w.max:Math.round(w.max*drift),reel=RODS3[cfg.rod].cap*.9;return Math.max(1,Math.min(cfg.bottomMode?bottom:cfg.depth,bottom,mx,reel))}
 function weights(cfg,spot,bottom,W,h,b){const hab=spot?spot.hab:'none',T=tod(h),rod=RODS3[cfg.rod],D=effDepth(cfg,bottom,W),bk=BAITS3[cfg.bait].key,moving=b&&Math.abs(b.u)>14&&Math.abs(b.u)<50,rows=[];
  for(const q of SEA){let w=(hab==='none'?.6:q.hab[hab]||0)*(q.b[bk]||0);if(!w){rows.push({q,w:0,why:'לא בפיתיון הזה או במקום הזה'});continue}
   const dr=(q.dn&&T==='night')?q.dn:q.d;let why='';
   if(q.bot){if(!(bottom>=dr[0]&&bottom<=dr[1])){w*=.05;why='התחתית לא בעומק שלו'}else if(D<bottom-8){w*=.08;why='צריך להגיע לתחתית'}}else if(D<dr[0]||D>dr[1]){w*=.07;why='לא בעומק שלו ('+dr[0]+'–'+dr[1]+' מ׳)'}
   const need=(q.rodN&&T==='night')?q.rodN:q.rod;if(rod.cls<need){w*=.3;why=why||'צריך חכה כבדה יותר'}
   if(q.tod==='dawn'&&T==='dawn')w*=1.7;else if(q.tod==='night'){w*=T==='night'?1.9:.55}else if(q.tod==='day'&&T==='day')w*=1.3;else if(T==='night'&&q.tod!=='night')w*=.6;
   if(W.wave<.5&&!q.bot)w*=.8;else if(W.wave<1.6)w*=1.2;else w*=.6;
   if(cfg.weight==='w0'){if(bk==='plug'&&moving&&!q.bot)w*=2.2;else w*=.25}
   rows.push({q,w,why})}
  return rows}

  S.f={phase:'drop',t0:NOW(),cfg:{...cfg},spot,bottom,W,depth:0,target:effDepth(cfg,bottom,W),side,line:0,T:0,run:0,runT:0,stam:1,hookT:0,biteAt:0};placePed(b);const anc=anchorDrop(b,true);
  toast((cfg.weight==='w0'?'הרפלה במים':'הפיתיון יורד — '+S.f.target+' מ׳')+(anc?' · העוגן במים — הסירה מחזיקה מקום'+(spot?' מעל "'+spot.name+'"':''):''));return true}
 function biteWait(f){const b=boatById(S.aboard),rows=weights(f.cfg,f.spot,f.bottom,f.W,clockNow().h,b),sum=rows.reduce((n,r)=>n+r.w,0);return{rows,sum,ms:(TUNE.w0+Math.random()*TUNE.w1)*1000/cl(sum/14,.35,1.7)*(b&&b.biteK||1)}}
 function fishStep(dt){const f=S.f;if(!f||f.phase==='idle')return;const t=NOW(),b=boatById(S.aboard);if(!b){S.f=null;return}
  if(f.phase==='drop'){const k=WEIGHTS3[f.cfg.weight].sink||3;if(t-f.t0>1100){f.depth=Math.min(f.target,f.depth+k*dt*1.6);if(f.depth>=f.target-.01){f.phase='wait';const w=biteWait(f);f.biteAt=t+w.ms;f.sum=w.sum}}return}
  if(f.phase==='wait'){if(f.cfg.weight==='w0')f.depth=cl(2+Math.abs(b.u)*.04,1,4);if(t>=f.biteAt){const w=biteWait(f);if(w.sum<.05){f.biteAt=t+9000;if(!f.toldNone){f.toldNone=1;toast('אין נשיכות — נסו עומק, פיתיון או נקודה אחרת')}return}
    let r=Math.random()*w.sum,q=w.rows[0].q;for(const x of w.rows){r-=x.w;if(r<=0){q=x.q;break}}const si=pickSize(RODS3[f.cfg.rod].cls,BAITS3[f.cfg.bait].key);f.row=makeRow(q,si,f);f.q=q;f.phase='bite';f.biteT=t;
    toast('נשיכה! F — להכות');try{SaveManager.log('fishing','sea_bite',{id:q.id,size:f.row.size,spot:f.spot&&f.spot.id,depth:Math.round(f.depth)})}catch(e){}}return}
  if(f.phase==='bite'){if(S.auto&&t-f.biteT>500)strike();else if(t-f.biteT>3200){f.phase='wait';f.biteAt=t+biteWait(f).ms;if(!BAITS3[f.cfg.bait].reuse&&Math.random()<.5){useBait(f.cfg.bait);toast('הדג לקח את הפיתיון — שמים פיתיון חדש')}else toast('הדג עזב — ממתינים שוב')}return}
  if(f.phase==='fight'){const rod=RODS3[f.cfg.rod],pow=f.row.weightKg*f.q.pow*.32,W=f.W;if(t>f.runT){const big=Math.random()<.45;f.run=big?(.45+Math.random()*.55)*f.stam:.12*f.stam;f.runT=t+(big?900+Math.random()*1900:700+Math.random()*1300)}
   const ratio=cl(pow*f.run/rod.line,0,2.2),noise=W.wave*.07*Math.sin(t/140)+(W.storm?.08*Math.sin(t/57):0),hold=S.auto?(f.T<.7):(S.hold||Input.down('KeyF'));
   let tt;if(hold){f.line=Math.max(0,f.line-rod.spd*TUNE.reel*(1-Math.min(.88,ratio*.75))*dt);tt=.24+ratio*.62+noise}else{if(f.run>.3)f.line+=ratio*4.2*dt;tt=.1+ratio*.36+noise*.5}
   f.T+=(tt-f.T)*Math.min(1,dt*4.5);f.stam=Math.max(.18,f.stam-dt*(hold?.045:.02)*(f.run>.3?1.6:1));
   if(f.q.id==='FS-SE-05'&&t-f.hookT<4500&&!hold&&Math.random()<.035*dt*30/30)return lose('הלוקוס נכנס לסלעים של השונית וקרע את החוט');
   if(f.T>=1)return lose('החוט נקרע — המתיחה גבוהה מדי');if(f.line>rod.cap)return lose('הסליל התרוקן — הדג לקח את כל החוט');if(Math.random()<(.004+W.wave*.004)*dt*(hold?1:.5))return lose('הקרס השתחרר');
   if(f.line<=1.6){const tool=TOOLS3[f.cfg.tool],ok=b.tools.includes(f.cfg.tool)&&f.row.weightKg<=tool.max;if(!ok&&Math.random()<.55)return lose(f.row.weightKg>15?'בלי גאף הדג הגדול נפל ליד הסירה':'הדג נפל ליד הסירה');f.phase='land';f.landT=t}return}
  if(f.phase==='land'){if(t-f.landT>900){f.phase='hold';f.holdT=t;finishCatch(f)}return}
  if(f.phase==='hold'){if(t-f.holdT>2800){S.f={phase:'idle',last:f.row,cfg:f.cfg};S.auto=false}return}
  if(f.phase==='lost'){if(t-f.lostT>1500)S.f={phase:'idle',cfg:f.cfg}}}
 function strike(){const f=S.f;if(!f||f.phase!=='bite')return;f.phase='fight';f.hookT=NOW();f.line=f.depth+6+Math.random()*6;f.T=.35;f.runT=0;f.stam=1;toast('הדג על הקרס! החזק F כדי לגלגל, ושחרר כשהמתיחה באדום')}
 function lose(msg){const f=S.f;f.phase='lost';S.auto=false;f.lostT=NOW();const fx=ensureFishingSchema();fx.totalEscaped=(fx.totalEscaped||0)+1;toast(msg);try{SaveManager.log('fishing','sea_lost',{id:f.row&&f.row.id,why:msg})}catch(e){}}
 function finishCatch(f){const fx=ensureFishingSchema(),row=f.row,prev=fx.records[row.id],rec=!prev||row.lengthCm>Number(prev.lengthCm||0);fx.inventory.push(row);if(fx.inventory.length>50)fx.inventory.shift();fx.totalCaught++;
  if(rec)fx.records[row.id]={...row,recordAt:isoNow()};if(!fx.bestValueCatch||Number(row.value||0)>Number(fx.bestValueCatch.value||0))fx.bestValueCatch={...row,bestValueAt:isoNow()};const p=P();p.caught=(p.caught||0)+1;
  try{recordTransaction('fish-caught',0,{fish:row.id,size:row.size,lengthCm:row.lengthCm,weightKg:row.weightKg,value:row.value,newRecord:rec,habitat:'sea'})}catch(e){}
  try{SaveManager.log('fishing','sea_caught',{id:row.id,lengthCm:row.lengthCm,weightKg:row.weightKg,spot:row.spot,depth:row.depthM})}catch(e){}try{syncAchievements(true)}catch(e){}
  try{fishx7Card(row,rec);const c=document.querySelector('#fishCatchCard .cf');if(c)c.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin','<span>'+kgTxt(row.weightKg)+'</span>')}catch(e){}
  try{if(S9STORY.step('F3-ST-FISH3')===3&&row.spot==='F3-SPOT-1')S9STORY.advance('F3-ST-FISH3')}catch(e){}try{SaveManager.save('fishing-catch',{backup:false,silent:true})}catch(e){}}
 function seaAction(){const b=boatById(S.aboard),f=S.f;if(S.menu){startDrop();return true}
  if(f&&f.phase==='bite'){strike();return true}if(f&&(f.phase==='fight'||f.phase==='land'||f.phase==='hold'))return true;

  openMenu();return true}

 function paintFish(root){const L=[...root.querySelectorAll('canvas[data-f3fish]')];if(!L.length)return;const mx=Math.max(...L.map(c=>+c.dataset.cm||50)),dpr=Math.min(2,window.devicePixelRatio||1);

   const gr=g.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);gr.addColorStop(0,'#1f7096');gr.addColorStop(1,'#11455f');g.fillStyle=gr;g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);g.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.07)';g.lineWidth=1;for(let y=9;y<H;y+=11){g.beginPath();for(let x=0;x<=W;x+=8)g.lineTo(x,y+Math.sin(x*.06+y)*1.1);g.stroke()}
   try{const I=TurboCity.info(id,{scale:1,sz:2,variant:0}),fp=(I.fp&&I.fp[2]>0)?I.fp:[0,0,I.w,I.h],fr=.3+.6*Math.sqrt(cm/mx),sc=Math.min(W*fr/fp[2],(H-16)/fp[3]),J=TurboCity.info(id,{scale:sc,sz:2,variant:0}),f2=(J.fp&&J.fp[2]>0)?J.fp:[0,0,J.w,J.h],x=W/2-(f2[0]+f2[2]/2),y=H/2-3-(f2[1]+f2[3]/2);

 for(const k in T)T[k].type=k;
 /* ================= הבנייה של כל סוג: רשימת חלקים בקואורדינטות של הגוף (פיקס׳, z במטרים) ================= */
 function build(type,L,B,lv,o){const ty=T[type],fb=ty.fb,P=[],box=(x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1,col,opt)=>P.push(Object.assign({k:'box',x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1,col},opt||{})),
   cyl=(x,y,r,z0,z1,col,band)=>P.push({k:'cyl',x,y,r,z0,z1,col,band}),mast=(x,y,z0,z1,w,col,opt)=>P.push(Object.assign({k:'mast',x,y,z0,z1,w,col},opt||{})),
   flat=(pts,z,col,line)=>P.push({k:'flat',pts,z,col,line}),ring=(x,y,z)=>P.push({k:'ring',x,y,z}),flag=(x,y,z)=>P.push({k:'flag',x,y,z}),
   motor=(x,n,big)=>P.push({k:'motor',x,n,big}),glass=(x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1)=>P.push({k:'glass',x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1}),seat=(x,y,w,d,col)=>box(x-d/2,x+d/2,y-w/2,y+w/2,fb,fb+.45,col||'#f2efe6',{top:col||'#e8e2d4'}),
   rail=(f0,f1,h)=>P.push({k:'rail',f0,f1,h:h||1}),lights={},m=L/ty.real[0];   /* m — פיקס׳ לכל מטר של הסוג (הגודל של המקום במשחק) */
  const SUP=lv.sup,GL=lv.glass||'#24394c',WIN={n:1,col:GL};
  switch(type){
   case'container':case'tanker':case'bulk':case'roro':{
    const aft=type==='roro'?L*.22:-L/2+L*.045,len=type==='container'?L*.1:type==='roro'?L*.12:L*.13,tiers=type==='container'?5:type==='roro'?3:4,tz=2.7,bw=B*.78;

    cyl(xa+len*.3+(type==='roro'?-len*.6:0),0,B*.1,zb,zb+5.5,lv.funnel,lv.hull);
    mast(x1-len*.2,0,zb+2.6,zb+9,1.4,'#e8ecee',{yard:B*.16,radar:B*.13,lightZ:zb+9});lights.mast=[x1-len*.2,0,zb+9];lights.side=[x1-len*.25,B*.5,zb+2.2];lights.stern=[-L/2,0,fb+1.5];lights.fwd=[L*.44,0,fb+ty.shape.sheer+8];
    mast(L*.44,0,fb+ty.shape.sheer,fb+ty.shape.sheer+8,1.1,'#e8ecee');ring(x1+1,-bw/2,fb+3.2);ring(x1+1,bw/2,fb+3.2);
    box(xa-len*.18,xa,-B*.32,B*.32,fb,fb+2.2,'#e07a1f',{top:'#f08a2a'});   /* סירת ההצלה בירכתיים */
    if(type==='container'&&!o.cargoLive){const rnd=(i=>()=>{i=Math.imul(i^(i>>>15),2246822507)+1013904223>>>0;return i/4294967296})(hash(o.id||'c')),bays=Math.floor((L*.78-len)/(13*m));

    lights.fb=fb;break}
   case'ferry':case'tour':{const c0=-L*.38,c1=L*.24;box(c0,c1,-B*.44,B*.44,fb,fb+2.5,SUP,{win:{n:1,col:GL,p:1.8*m,round:1},stripe:lv.stripe,text:type==='ferry'?'מעבורת':null});   /* D‑583: השלט על הדופן של המבנה */

    ring(c1+1,-B*.44,fb+1.4);ring(c1+1,B*.44,fb+1.4);ring(c0-1,B*.44,fb+1.4);flag(-L/2+2,0,fb+1.2);

 function lightsOf(c,F,M,N,o,spec,lod){const Lt=M.lights,L=spec.L,B=spec.B,a=cl(N*1.2,0,1),r=Math.max(5,Math.min(24,L*.05+4)),under=o.under||(o.u||0)>3,refl=(o.anchor==='deck'?0:1);

   if(Lt.mast)lamp(c,...P(Lt.mast),'white',r*.8,a,ry(Lt.mast));if(Lt.fwd)lamp(c,...P(Lt.fwd),'white',r*.7,a,ry(Lt.fwd));if(Lt.stern)lamp(c,...P(Lt.stern),'white',r*.6,a,ry(Lt.stern))}

  if(Lt.beacon==='pilot'&&Lt.mast){lamp(c,...P([Lt.mast[0],0,Lt.mast[2]-.5]),'white',r*.5,a*.9,0);lamp(c,...P([Lt.mast[0],0,Lt.mast[2]-1.1]),'red',r*.5,a*.9,0)}
  if((Lt.work&&o.fishing)||(L>200&&!under)){const q=Lt.stern?P([Lt.stern[0]+L*.08,0,Lt.stern[2]+1.2]):P([0,0,M.fb+3]);lamp(c,...q,'warm',r*1.6,a*.55,0)}
  if(L>400){for(let x=-L*.3;x<L*.35;x+=L*.16)lamp(c,...P([x,0,M.fb+6]),'warm',r*1.1,a*.35,0)}}
 /* השובל: שני גלי הצד (זווית קלווין, 19.5°), הקצף מאחור וגלי החרטום. מההיסטוריה של המקום, או לאורך הכיוון */

 const TRL=new Map(),WK=new Map();
 function trailRec(spec,F,o){const now=performance.now(),k=spec.id;let T=TRL.get(k);const sx=F.x-F.c*spec.L*.5,sy=F.y-F.s*spec.L*.5,u=o.u||0;

 function wake(c,F,spec,o,lod){const L=spec.L,B=spec.B,u=o.u||0,T=o.trail,k=cl(u/(L>200?30:45),.15,1)*(1-.55*(o.night!=null?o.night:nightNow())),fz=o.anchor==='deck'?F.zr*KZ:0;c.save();c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';
  const sideways=o.vx!=null&&Math.abs(-o.vx*F.s+o.vy*F.c)>Math.abs(o.vx*F.c+o.vy*F.s)*1.2;
  if(sideways){const vn=Math.hypot(o.vx,o.vy)||1,nx=-o.vx/vn,ny=-o.vy/vn;c.fillStyle='rgba(240,250,255,'+(.3*k).toFixed(2)+')';c.beginPath();
   const a=[F.x-F.c*L*.45+nx*B*.5,F.y-F.s*L*.45+ny*B*.5+fz],b=[F.x+F.c*L*.45+nx*B*.5,F.y+F.s*L*.45+ny*B*.5+fz];c.moveTo(a[0],a[1]);c.lineTo(b[0],b[1]);c.lineTo(b[0]+nx*B*.5,b[1]+ny*B*.5);c.lineTo(a[0]+nx*B*.5,a[1]+ny*B*.5);c.fill();c.restore();return}
  const now=performance.now(),maxAge=Math.min(6,3*L/Math.max(u,1)),stern={x:F.x-F.c*L*.5,y:F.y-F.s*L*.5,h:F.h,u,t:now},P=[stern];if(T)for(let i=T.length-1;i>=0;i--){const q=T[i],ag=(now-q.t)/1000;if(ag>maxAge)break;P.push(q)}
  if(P.length>1&&Math.hypot(P[1].x-P[0].x,P[1].y-P[0].y)>Math.max(14,u*.2))P.length=1;   /* כמעט עומד והדרך רחוקה — בלי שובל מנותק */
  if(P.length>1){let run=0;for(let i=1;i<P.length;i++){const d=Math.hypot(P[i].x-P[i-1].x,P[i].y-P[i-1].y);if(run+d>3*L){const f=(3*L-run)/Math.max(1e-6,d);P[i]=Object.assign({},P[i],{x:P[i-1].x+(P[i].x-P[i-1].x)*f,y:P[i-1].y+(P[i].y-P[i-1].y)*f});run=3*L;P.length=i+1;break}run+=d}

     if(prev){c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+(.55*(1-f)*k).toFixed(3)+')';c.lineWidth=Math.max(.6,B*.04)+ag*.45;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(prev[0],prev[1]);c.lineTo(pt[0],pt[1]);c.stroke()}prev=pt}}
   for(const q of P){const ag=(now-q.t)/1000;if(ag>1.8)break;c.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+(.3*(1-ag/1.8)*k).toFixed(3)+')';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(q.x,q.y+fz,B*.3+ag*B*.12,B*.2+ag*B*.06,q.h,0,TAU);c.fill()}}
  /* גלי החרטום — קצרים, צמודים לחרטום */
  const bx=F.x+F.c*L*.5,by=F.y+F.s*L*.5+fz;for(const side of[1,-1]){const nx=-F.s*side,ny=F.c*side;c.strokeStyle='rgba(250,253,255,'+(.7*k).toFixed(2)+')';c.lineWidth=Math.max(.7,B*.05);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(bx,by);
   c.quadraticCurveTo(bx-F.c*L*.1+nx*B*.45,by-F.s*L*.1+ny*B*.45,bx-F.c*L*.26+nx*B*.58,by-F.s*L*.26+ny*B*.58);c.stroke()}
  c.restore()}
 /* הבדיקה (D‑592): לכל כלי שזז — האורך של השובל שמצויר (לכל היותר פי 3 מאורכו) והמרחק של תחילת השובל מהירכתיים */
 function wakeAudit(){const now=performance.now(),rows=[];for(const [id,w] of WK){if(now-w.t>1500)continue;rows.push({id,L:Math.round(w.L),u:w.u,len:w.len,ratio:+(w.len/w.L).toFixed(2),firstGap:w.gap})}
